l-e-m3-b01-01.title: Ahịrịokwu if ọ na-ekwu maka ọdịnihu mgbe niile?
l-e-m3-b01-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta ‘Ahịrịokwu if na-ekwu mgbe niile banyere ihe ga-eme n'ọdịnihu’ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-egosi na ọ bụghị eziokwu (counterexample).
l-e-m3-b01-01.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrịokwu malitere na if na-ekwu mgbe niile banyere ihe ga-eme n'ọdịnihu. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-m3-b01-01.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-ekwu maka mmiri ozuzo ga-abịa n'ọdịnihu. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b01-01.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ekwu banyere ihe mmadụ ga-eme ngwa ngwa n'ọdịnihu. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b01-01.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ekwu banyere ajụjụ a ga-ajụ n'ọdịnihu. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b01-01.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na i kpoo ice ọkụ, ọ na-agbaze mgbe niile. A na-ejikwa if maka eziokwu na-adị mgbe niile, ya mere ọ bụghị naanị maka ọdịnihu.
l-e-m3-b01-01.s.s2.model.0: ‘Ọ bụrụ na i kpoo ice ọkụ, ọ na-agbaze’ anaghị ekwu maka ọdịnihu kama ọ bụ eziokwu na-adị mgbe niile, ya mere nkwupụta ahụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b01-01.s.s2.model.1: Ice na-agbaze mgbe niile, ya mere nke a bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta na if na-ekwu naanị maka ọdịnihu.

l-e-m3-b01-02.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta ‘Okwu nwere ngwụcha -ing na-egosi mgbe niile na ihe na-eme ugbu a’ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b01-02.material: Nkwupụta: Okwu nwere ngwụcha -ing na-egosi mgbe niile ‘na-eme ihe ugbu a’, ya bụ ihe na-aga n'ihu. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-m3-b01-02.s.s1.r.a: Otu onye na-eche ụgbọ ala ọha ugbu a. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b01-02.s.s1.r.c: Otu onye na-ede akwụkwọ ozi ugbu a. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b01-02.s.s1.r.d: Otu onye na-agbọ ụja ugbu a. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b01-02.s.s1.explain: Interesting pụtara na akwụkwọ ahụ nwere àgwà nke ịbụ ‘na-adọrọ mmasị’. Ọ pụtaghị na ọ na-eme ihe ugbu a.
l-e-m3-b01-02.s.s2.model.0: Interesting dị na ‘interesting book’ na-akọ àgwà akwụkwọ ahụ (na-adọrọ mmasị), ya mere ọ naghị egosi ihe na-aga n'ihu.
l-e-m3-b01-02.s.s2.model.1: Akwụkwọ ahụ anaghị eme ihe ugbu a, ya mere interesting bụ ihe atụ na-egosi na ọ bụghị ihe na-aga n'ihu.

l-e-m3-b01-04.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta ‘Relative pronoun a na-eji akọwa mmadụ ga-abụ naanị who’ bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b01-04.material: Nkwupụta: Relative pronoun a na-eji akọwa mmadụ bụ naanị otu okwu, who. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere nkwupụta a.

l-e-m3-b01-05.material: Nkwupụta: Ọ bụrụ na ederede nwere ọnụọgụ dịka nsonaazụ nyocha, a pụrụ ịtụkwasị ya obi mgbe niile. Chọta ederede megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-m3-b01-05.s.s1.r.a: A jụrụ mmadụ 1,000 a họọrọ n'amaghị ama, ya mere a pụrụ ịtụkwasị ya obi. Ọ bụ ihe atụ kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m3-b04-01.title: A naghị eji will mgbe if gasịrị?
l-e-m3-b04-01.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta ‘a naghị eji will n'ime nkebi if’ ziri ezi mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ebe ọ na-abụghị eziokwu (counterexample).
l-e-m3-b04-01.material: Nkwupụta: A naghị eji will n'ime akụkụ malitere na if. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere nke a.
l-e-m3-b04-01.s.s1.r.b: Will dị na nkebi isi, nkebi if dịkwa n'oge ugbu a. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-01.s.s1.r.c: Will dị na nkebi isi, nkebi if dịkwa n'oge ugbu a. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-01.s.s1.r.d: Will dị na nkebi isi, nkebi if dịkwa n'oge ugbu a. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-01.s.s1.explain: If dị na wonder if pụtara ‘ma’, ya mere will na-esote ya. Ọ dị iche na if nke na-egosi ọnọdụ.
l-e-m3-b04-01.s.s2.model.0: ‘I wonder if it will rain tomorrow.’ nwere will mgbe if gasịrị, ya mere nkwupụta na a naghị eji ya mgbe if gasịrị ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b04-01.s.s2.model.1: If a pụtara ‘ma mmiri ga-ezo’, ya mere a pụrụ iji will mgbe if gasịrị, nke a na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m3-b04-02.title: Okwu niile nwere ngwụcha -ed ọ̀ na-ekwu maka oge gara aga?
l-e-m3-b04-02.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta ‘okwu ọ bụla nwere ngwụcha -ed pụtara oge gara aga’ ziri ezi mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b04-02.material: Nkwupụta: Okwu ọ bụla nwere ngwụcha -ed pụtara ‘ihe e mere n'oge gara aga’. Chọta okwu megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-m3-b04-02.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ekwu maka ihe e mere n'oge gara aga. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-02.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-ekwu maka ihe e mere n'oge gara aga. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-02.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-ekwu maka ihe e mere n'oge gara aga. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-02.s.s1.explain: Crowded na ‘crowded bus’ na-akọ ọnọdụ igwe mmadụ juru. Ọ bụghị ihe e mere n'oge gara aga.
l-e-m3-b04-02.s.s2.model.0: Crowded na ‘crowded bus’ na-akọ ọnọdụ ụgbọ ala juru ugbu a, ya mere nkwupụta na -ed niile bụ oge gara aga ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b04-02.s.s2.model.1: Crowded na-akọ ọnọdụ ụgbọ ala ahụ, ọ pụtaghị ihe e mere n'oge gara aga, ya mere ọ bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m3-b04-03.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta ‘ajụjụ na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem na-enwe okwu ajụjụ mgbe niile’ ziri ezi, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b04-03.material: Nkwupụta: Ajụjụ na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem na-enwe okwu ajụjụ dịka where ma ọ bụ what mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-m3-b04-03.s.s1.r.b: O nwere okwu ajụjụ where. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-03.s.s1.r.c: O nwere okwu ajụjụ what. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m3-b04-03.s.s2.model.0: ‘I wonder whether they won.’ nwere whether kama okwu ajụjụ, ya mere nkwupụta na a ga-enwe okwu ajụjụ mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b04-03.s.s2.model.1: Ajụjụ na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem nke whether webatara enweghị where ma ọ bụ what, ya mere ahịrịokwu a na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m3-b04-04.title: Ọkwa kpakpando 5 ọ̀ pụtara na mkpesa adịghị?
l-e-m3-b04-04.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta ‘nyocha nwere ọkwa kpakpando 5 enweghị mkpesa’ ziri ezi mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b04-04.material: Nkwupụta: Nyocha nwere kpakpando 5 enweghị mkpesa ọ bụla sitere n'aka onye zụtara ya. Chọta nyocha megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-m3-b04-04.s.s1.r.a: O nweghị ọkwa kpakpando 5, ya mere nyocha ahụ enweghị njikọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-04.s.s1.r.b: O nweghị ọkwa kpakpando 5, ya mere nyocha ahụ enweghị njikọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-04.s.s1.r.c: O nwere otuto naanị, enweghị mkpesa. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-04.s.s1.explain: Ọkwa ya bụ kpakpando 5, ma e nwere mkpesa: ọ bịara agbajiri. A pụghị ikpebi ihe e dere naanị site n'ọkwa ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-04.s.s2.model.0: Ọbụna na ọkwa 5, e nwere mkpesa na ọ bịara agbajiri, ya mere nkwupụta na ọkwa 5 pụtara na mkpesa adịghị ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b04-04.s.s2.model.1: Ọbụna ọkwa dị elu pụrụ inwe mkpesa n'ime ederede, ya mere nyocha a bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m3-b04-05.title: A ga-eji relative pronoun mgbe niile?
l-e-m3-b04-05.goal: Nyochaa ma nkwupụta ‘a gaghị ahapụ relative pronoun’ ziri ezi mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b04-05.material: Nkwupụta: A pụghị ịhapụ relative pronoun n'ahịrịokwu ọ bụla. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere nkwupụta a.
l-e-m3-b04-05.s.s1.r.a: Who na-arụ ọrụ dị ka isiokwu, ya mere ịhapụ ya na-eme ka ahịrịokwu ahụ bụrụ nke na-ezighi ezi. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-05.s.s1.r.b: Who na-arụ ọrụ dị ka isiokwu, ya mere ịhapụ ya na-eme ka ahịrịokwu ahụ bụrụ nke na-ezighi ezi. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-05.s.s1.r.d: Which na-arụ ọrụ dị ka isiokwu, ya mere ịhapụ ya na-eme ka ahịrịokwu ahụ bụrụ nke na-ezighi ezi. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-05.s.s1.explain: Na ‘The book (that) I bought’, that bụ object, ya mere ahịrịokwu ahụ ka ziri ezi ma a hapụ ya.
l-e-m3-b04-05.s.s2.model.0: ‘The book I bought’ bụ ahịrịokwu ziri ezi n'enweghị relative pronoun, ya mere nkwupụta na a gaghị ahapụ ya ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b04-05.s.s2.model.1: A pụrụ ịhapụ relative pronoun na-arụ ọrụ object, ya mere ahịrịokwu a na-enweghị that tupu I bought bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m3-b06-01.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na ahịrịokwu isi nke ahịrịokwu ọnọdụ ga-enwerịrị will ziri ezi mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ na-egosi na ọ bụghị eziokwu.
l-e-m3-b06-01.material: Nkwupụta: Ahịrịokwu isi nke ahịrịokwu ọnọdụ nwere if ga-enwerịrị will. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-01.s.s1.explain: Iwu nwekwara ike ịdị na nkebi isi. ‘Take a rest’ enweghị will.
l-e-m3-b06-01.s.s2.model.0: ‘Take a rest’ bụ iwu na-enweghị will, ya mere nkwupụta na nkebi isi ga-enwerịrị will ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b06-01.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu isi nke ‘If you are tired, take a rest.’ enweghị will, ya mere ahịrịokwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere nkwupụta ahụ.

l-e-m3-b06-02.title: Adjective nwere -ing ọ̀ na-akọwa naanị ihe?
l-e-m3-b06-02.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na adjective -ing na-akọwa naanị ihe ziri ezi mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b06-02.material: Nkwupụta: Adjective -ing na-akpata mmetụta na-akọwa naanị ihe, ọ naghị akọwa mmadụ. Chọta okwu megidere nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-02.s.s1.r.a: Akwụkwọ bụ ihe. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-02.s.s1.r.b: Njem bụ ihe. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-02.s.s1.r.d: Nsonaazụ bụ ihe. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-02.s.s1.explain: Adjective -ing nwekwara ike ịkọwa mmadụ. Onye na-eme ka ndị ọzọ nwee ike ọgwụgwụ bụ boring teacher.
l-e-m3-b06-02.s.s2.model.0: Na ‘boring teacher’, boring na-akọwa onye nkuzi, ya mere nkwupụta na -ing na-akọwa naanị ihe ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b06-02.s.s2.model.1: Onye nkuzi ahụ bụ onye na-eme ka mmadụ nwee ike ọgwụgwụ, ya mere okwu a nke ji -ing kọwaa mmadụ bụkwa ihe atụ megidere ya.

l-e-m3-b06-03.title: Oge ngwaa dị n'ime ahịrịokwu ga-abụrịrị otu mgbe niile?
l-e-m3-b06-03.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na ngwaa dị n'ajụjụ na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem na-enwe otu oge ngwaa na ahịrịokwu isi ziri ezi mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b06-03.material: Nkwupụta: Ngwaa dị n'ajụjụ na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem na-enwekarị otu oge ngwaa na ngwaa dị n'ahịrịokwu mpụta. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b06-03.s.s1.r.b: Ngwaa abụọ ahụ dị n'otu oge. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-03.s.s1.r.c: Ngwaa abụọ ahụ dị n'otu oge. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-03.s.s1.r.d: Ngwaa abụọ ahụ dị n'otu oge. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-03.s.s1.explain: Oge ihe ị na-ajụ maka ya ugbu a (know) na oge ihe malitere ugbua (started) dị iche, ya mere ọ dị mma ka oge ngwaa ha dị iche.
l-e-m3-b06-03.s.s2.model.0: Na ‘Do you know ... started’, know dị ugbu a, started dịkwa n'oge gara aga, ya mere oge ha dị iche; nkwupụta na ha ga-abụrịrị otu ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b06-03.s.s2.model.1: Mgbe oge a jụrụ ajụjụ na oge ihe mere dị iche, oge ngwaa nwekwara ike ịdị iche, ya mere ahịrịokwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere ya.

l-e-m3-b06-04.title: Whose ọ̀ na-eji naanị maka mmadụ?
l-e-m3-b06-04.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na a na-eji whose naanị maka mmadụ ziri ezi mgbe niile, chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b06-04.material: Nkwupụta: Relative pronoun whose nke na-egosi onye nwe ihe, bụ naanị maka mmadụ. Chọta okwu megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b06-04.s.s1.r.a: Dọkịta bụ mmadụ. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-04.s.s1.r.b: Nwa akwụkwọ bụ mmadụ. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-04.s.s1.r.c: Onye nkuzi bụ mmadụ. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-04.s.s1.explain: A na-ejikwa whose maka ihe. ‘A tree whose leaves’ pụtara ‘osisi nwere akwụkwọ edo edo’.
l-e-m3-b06-04.s.s2.model.0: Na ‘a tree whose leaves’, whose bụ maka ihe ahụ bụ tree, ya mere nkwupụta na a na-eji ya naanị maka mmadụ ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b06-04.s.s2.model.1: A na-egosikwa onye nwe ihe site n'ihe, dịka akwụkwọ osisi, na whose, ya mere okwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere ya.

l-e-m3-b06-05.title: Echiche mmadụ ọ̀ na-abịa mgbe However gasịrị mgbe niile?
l-e-m3-b06-05.goal: Chee ma nkwupụta na echiche onye dere ya na-abịa mgbe However gasịrị ziri ezi mgbe niile; chọta ma kọwaa ihe atụ megidere ya.
l-e-m3-b06-05.material: Nkwupụta: Mgbe However gasịrị, echiche onye dere ya na-abịa mgbe niile. Chọta ahịrịokwu megidere nke a.
l-e-m3-b06-05.s.s1.r.b: Ọ na-akọ echiche onye dere ya. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-akọ echiche onye dere ya. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-05.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-akọ echiche onye dere ya. Nke a kwekọrọ na nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-05.s.s1.explain: Eziokwu a pụrụ inyocha nwekwara ike ịbịa mgbe However gasịrị. Oge ụlọ ahịa na-emechi bụ eziokwu.
l-e-m3-b06-05.s.s2.model.0: Ihe na-eso However, ‘ụlọ ahịa na-emechi n'elekere 6’, bụ eziokwu a pụrụ inyocha, ya mere nkwupụta na ọ bụ echiche mgbe niile ezighị ezi.
l-e-m3-b06-05.s.s2.model.1: However bụ okwu na-ejikọta ọdịnaya dị iche na nke gara aga, ya mere eziokwu nwekwara ike iso ya; ahịrịokwu a bụ ihe atụ megidere ya.

l-e-m3-b07-01.title: -ing phrase na mmalite ọ̀ nwere ike ijikọ n'ahịrịokwu ọ bụla?
l-e-m3-b07-01.goal: Lelee ma nkwupụta "an -ing phrase at the start of a sentence can be added to any sentence" bụ eziokwu mgbe niile, ma chọta ma kọwaa ikpe ebe ọ bụghị (ihe atụ megidere).
l-e-m3-b07-01.material: Nkwupụta: If you put an -ing phrase at the start of a sentence, it sounds natural before any sentence. Chọta ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta a.
l-e-m3-b07-01.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu na-emegide nkwupụta ahụ (na-ada ihe ọjọọ).
l-e-m3-b07-01.s.s1.r.a: Onye gụrụ akwụkwọ ahụ na onye hiri ụra abụọ bụ "I." Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b07-01.s.s1.r.c: Onye nwere mmetụta oyi na onye yi uwe mwụda bụ otu. Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b07-01.s.s1.r.d: Onye jere ije na onye hụrụ abụọ bụ "I." Nke a bụ ihe atụ nke kwekọrọ n'nkwupụta ahụ.
l-e-m3-b07-01.s.s1.explain: Omume dị n'-ing phrase ga-abụrịrị ihe isiokwu nke ahịrịokwu na-esote mere. Mmiri ozuzo enweghị ike ichere bọs.
l-e-m3-b07-01.s.s2.model.0: "Waiting for the bus" bụ ihe mmadụ na-eme, ma isiokwu bụ "the rain," ya mere ọ na-ada ihe ọjọọ. Nke ahụ mere nkwupụta ji ezighi ezi.

l-e-m3-b01-06.title: Ụkpụrụ na-ekewa will na would
l-e-m3-b01-06.goal: Iji chọpụta ụkpụrụ na-ekewa will na would n'ahịrịokwu if, họrọ ozi dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b01-06.material: ① If it snows tomorrow, we will make a snowman. ② If I were a bird, I would fly. Will ka ọ bụ would: chọta ozi dị ezigbo mkpa iji kpebie nke a ga-eji.
l-e-m3-b01-06.s.s1.o.a: Ma isiokwu nke ahịrịokwu bụ isi bụ I.
l-e-m3-b01-06.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma isiokwu ha bụ otu, will na would nwere ike ịdị iche.
l-e-m3-b01-06.s.s1.o.b: Ma ihe dị n'ahịrịokwu if nwere ike ime n'ezie ka ọ bụ naanị ihe e chepụtara echepụta.
l-e-m3-b01-06.s.s1.r.c: Koma abụghị ụkpụrụ na-ekewa will na would.
l-e-m3-b01-06.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo ahịrịokwu abụghị ụkpụrụ na-ekewa will na would.
l-e-m3-b01-06.s.s1.explain: Jiri will maka ihe nwere ike ime, would maka ihe e chepụtara echepụta ma ọ bụ ihe na-agaghị adị mfe ime.
l-e-m3-b01-06.s.s2.model.0: Ị kwesịrị ịma ma ihe dị n'ahịrịokwu if nwere ike ime n'ezie, ya mere ụkpụrụ a dị ezigbo mkpa. Koma ma ọ bụ ogologo ahịrịokwu adịghị mkpa.
l-e-m3-b01-06.s.s2.model.1: Snow nwere ike ịda, ya mere eji will; iche n'echiche ịbụ nnụnụ na-eji would. Ya mere ụkpụrụ bụ ma ọ ga-ekwe omume ka ọ bụ echiche efu.

l-e-m3-b01-07.title: Ụkpụrụ na-ekewa mkpọpụta -ed
l-e-m3-b01-07.goal: Iji chọpụta ụkpụrụ na-ekpebi otú e si akpọ -ed mgbe ngwaa gasịrị, họrọ ozi dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b01-07.material: walked /t/, played /d/, wanted /id/. Ha nwere otu -ed, ma mkpọpụta dị iche. Chọta ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa iji kpebie mkpọpụta ya.
l-e-m3-b01-07.s.s1.r.c: Okwu atọ ahụ niile dị n'oge gara aga, ma mkpọpụta ha dị iche.
l-e-m3-b01-07.s.s1.o.d: Ma ngwaa ahụ dị na mmalite ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b01-07.s.s1.r.d: Ọnọdụ ya n'ahịrịokwu enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na mkpọpụta -ed.
l-e-m3-b01-07.s.s1.explain: A na-ekpebi mkpọpụta -ed site n'ụda ikpeazụ nke ngwaa. Mgbe k gasịrị ọ bụ /t/, mgbe ụdaume gasịrị ọ bụ /d/, mgbe t ma ọ bụ d gasịrị ọ bụ /id/.
l-e-m3-b01-07.s.s2.model.0: Walk na-ejedebe na k, play na-ejedebe na ụdaume, want na-ejedebe na t, ya mere ụda -ed na-agbanwe. Ụda ikpeazụ bụ ụkpụrụ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b01-07.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede na oge ngwaa bụ otu n'okwu atọ ahụ, ya mere ị ga-eleba anya n'ụda ikpeazụ nke ngwaa.

l-e-m3-b01-08.title: Ụkpụrụ na-ekewa that na if
l-e-m3-b01-08.goal: Iji chọpụta ụkpụrụ na-ekpebi okwu njikọ ga-esote I know/I wonder, họrọ ozi dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b01-08.material: ① I know that the gym is open. ② I wonder if the gym is open. ① nwere eziokwu a maara, ② nwekwara ajụjụ a na-eche. Chọta ụkpụrụ na-ekewa that na if.
l-e-m3-b01-08.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ nwere gym dị n'ọnụọgụ otu.
l-e-m3-b01-08.s.s1.o.b: Ma oge ngwaa ọ bụ ugbu a.
l-e-m3-b01-08.s.s1.r.b: Oge ngwaa anaghị ekewa that na if.
l-e-m3-b01-08.s.s1.o.c: Ma ihe dị n'ime ya bụ eziokwu ka ọ bụ ajụjụ.
l-e-m3-b01-08.s.s1.o.d: Ma akara ntụpọ dị na njedebe ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b01-08.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ ji akara ntụpọ mechie.
l-e-m3-b01-08.s.s1.explain: Jiri that mgbe ị na-akọ eziokwu; jiri if ma ọ bụ whether mgbe ọ bụ ajụjụ ee/ọ dịghị ị na-eche.
l-e-m3-b01-08.s.s2.model.0: ① na-ekwu eziokwu na ọ meghere, ② na-ajụ ma ọ meghere, ya mere ụkpụrụ bụ ma ihe dị n'ime ya bụ eziokwu ka ọ bụ ajụjụ.
l-e-m3-b01-08.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ otu na akara ntụpọ bụ otu n'ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ, ya mere ị ga-ekewa ha site n'ịmata ma ọdịnaya ọ bụ eziokwu ka ọ bụ ajụjụ.

l-e-m3-b01-09.title: Ụkpụrụ na-ekewa what na that
l-e-m3-b01-09.goal: Iji chọpụta ụkpụrụ na-ekewa relative pronoun what na that, họrọ ozi dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b01-09.material: ① I like ___ you wrote. ② I like the story ___ you wrote. A na-etinye what na ①, that na ②. Chọta ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa iji kewaa ha.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.o.a: Ma e nwere aha n'ihu a ga-akọwa.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.r.b: N'ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ, you bụ isiokwu.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.o.c: Ma wrote dị n'oge gara aga.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.r.c: N'ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ, wrote dị n'oge gara aga.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo anaghị ekewa what na that.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere aha n'ihu a ga-akọwa (story), jiri that. Ọ bụrụ na aha dị otú ahụ adịghị ma ihe a na-ekwu bụ ‘ihe ahụ nke ...’, jiri what.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s2.model.0: ② nwere story n'ihu, ya mere ọ na-eji that; ① enweghị aha a ga-akọwa, ya mere ọ na-eji what. Ya mere ụkpụrụ bụ ma aha dị n'ihu.
l-e-m3-b01-09.s.s2.model.1: You na wrote bụ otu n'ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ, ya mere ịmata ma aha dị n'ihu dị ezigbo mkpa.

l-e-m3-b01-10.goal: Iji chọpụta ụkpụrụ na-ekewa ihe e dere kpọmkwem n'ederede na ihe e chepụtara, họrọ ozi dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b01-10.material: Ederede: Ụzọ ndị ahụ dị mmiri n'ụtụtụ a. ① Ụzọ ndị ahụ dị mmiri. ② Mmiri zoro n'abalị gara aga. ① bụ ihe e dere n'ederede, ② bụ ihe e chepụtara. Chọta ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa iji kewaa ha.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.a: Ogologo anaghị ekewa ihe e dere na ihe e chere.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.o.b: Ma e dere ya kpọmkwem n'ederede.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọ dị n'oge gara aga.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ na-ekwu maka oge gara aga, ya mere oge ngwaa enweghị ike ikewa ha.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.o.d: Ma okwu ndị ahụ siri ike.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.r.d: Siri ike nke okwu abụghị ụkpụrụ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s1.explain: Ihe e dere kpọmkwem n'ederede bụ ọdịnaya; ihe i chọpụtara site n'ihe na-egosi ya bụ echiche e mere (inference).
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.0: ① ka e dere kpọmkwem n'ederede, ② edeghị ya, ya mere ụkpụrụ bụ ma e dere ya kpọmkwem.
l-e-m3-b01-10.s.s2.model.1: Oge ngwaa na ogologo ha bụ otu, ya mere a ga-ekewa ha site n'ịmata ma e dere ya kpọmkwem n'ederede.

l-e-m3-b03-06.material: ① If you eat too much, you will feel sick. ② If you eat too much, you might feel sick. will ma ọ bụ might: chọta ọkọlọtọ dị mkpa n'ezie iji kpebie nke a ga-eji.

l-e-m3-b03-07.material: ① a sleeping baby ② a sleeping bag. N'abụọ, sleeping dị tupu noun, mana ihe pụtara dị iche. Chọta ọkọlọtọ dị mkpa n'ezie iji kewaa ihe pụtara.
l-e-m3-b03-07.s.s1.o.a: Ma noun na-eme omume ma ọ bụ nwee ebumnuche

l-e-m3-b03-07.s.s1.r.d: Tense enweghị ihe metụtara ọdịiche dị n'ihe okwu abụọ ahụ pụtara.

l-e-m3-b03-09.title: Ọkọlọtọ maka ma nkọwa dị mkpa n'ezie
l-e-m3-b03-09.goal: Iji chọta ọkọlọtọ na-ekewa relative clause nwere comma na nke na-enweghị, chọpụta ọkọlọtọ (ozi) nke dị mkpa n'ezie, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị họọrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b03-09.material: ① The book that is on the table is mine. ② My book, which is on the table, is new. ① enweghị comma ma ② nwere comma. Chọta ọkọlọtọ dị mkpa n'ezie iji kpebie eji comma.
l-e-m3-b03-09.s.s1.o.a: Ma ị na-eji which ma ọ bụ that
l-e-m3-b03-09.s.s1.r.a: A na-ekpebi comma site n'ọrụ nke nkọwa, ọ bụghị site n'ọdịiche dị n'etiti that na which.
l-e-m3-b03-09.s.s1.o.b: Ma nkọwa dị mkpa n'ezie iji mata ihe ahụ
l-e-m3-b03-09.s.s1.explain: Nkọwa nke dị mkpa n'ezie iji mata ihe ahụ na-aga n'enweghị commas, ma a na-ekewa nkọwa agbakwunyere site na commas.
l-e-m3-b03-09.s.s2.model.0: ① bụ nkọwa na-ahọrọ otu n'etiti ọtụtụ akwụkwọ ma ② bụ nkọwa agbakwunyere, ya mere ma ọ dị mkpa n'ezie iji kewaa ha bụ ọkọlọtọ.
l-e-m3-b03-09.s.s2.model.1: Ogologo na tense yiri ibe ha n'ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ, ya mere ị ga-ele ma nkọwa ahụ dị mkpa iji họrọ ihe ahụ.

l-e-m3-b03-10.title: Ọkọlọtọ na-ekewa ọkwa na nyocha
l-e-m3-b03-10.goal: Iji chọta ọkọlọtọ na-ekewa ebumnuche nke ederede, chọpụta ọkọlọtọ (ozi) nke dị mkpa n'ezie, ma kọwaa ihe mere ị họọrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b03-10.material: ① Our sports day is on May 3. Please bring a water bottle. ② Sports day was fun. We ran and laughed all afternoon. Chọta ọkọlọtọ dị mkpa n'ezie iji kewaa ebumnuche (ọkwa, nyocha) nke ederede abụọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b03-10.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna ma ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu bụ otu, ebumnuche nke ederede dị iche.
l-e-m3-b03-10.s.s1.r.b: May bụ naanị okwu ụbọchị ma ọ naghị ekewa ebumnuche nke ederede.
l-e-m3-b03-10.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọ na-ekwupụta ihe dị n'ihu ma ọ bụ na-elegharị anya n'ihe gara aga
l-e-m3-b03-10.s.s1.r.d: Okwu maka ihe a ga-ebute abụghị ọkọlọtọ na-ekewa ebumnuche nke ederede.
l-e-m3-b03-10.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-ekwupụta ihe a ga-eme n'ọdịnihu, ọ bụ ọkwa, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ na-elegharị anya n'oge gara aga, ọ bụ nyocha.
l-e-m3-b03-10.s.s2.model.0: ① na-ekwupụta emume ọdịnihu na ihe a ga-ebute ma ② na-elegharị anya n'emume gwụchara, ya mere ma ọ bụ banyere ọdịnihu ma ọ bụ oge gara aga bụ ọkọlọtọ.
l-e-m3-b03-10.s.s2.model.1: Ọnụọgụ ahịrịokwu na okwu ụbọchị enweghị ihe metụtara ebumnuche nke ederede, ya mere ị ga-ele oge na eji.

l-e-m3-b04-06.title: Gịnị ka e ji ahọrọ if na because?
l-e-m3-b04-06.goal: Iji chọpụta njikọ dabara n'etiti if na because, mata ụkpụrụ (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b04-06.material: Họrọ if ma ọ bụ because maka oghere dịka I stayed home ___ it rained. / I will stay home ___ it rains. Chọta ụkpụrụ a ga-eji họrọ.
l-e-m3-b04-06.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa iji mee nhọrọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-06.s.s1.o.b: Ma ihe ahụ emeworị ka ọ bụ na a maghị ma ọ ga-eme.
l-e-m3-b04-06.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo enweghị ike ikpebi njikọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-06.s.s1.explain: Jiri because maka ihe kpatara ihe merela, jiri if maka ọnọdụ nke ihe a na-amaghị ma ọ ga-eme.
l-e-m3-b04-06.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na mmiri ezorola, ọ bụ ihe kpatara ya, ya mere jiri because; ọ bụrụ na amabeghị ma mmiri ga-ezo, ọ bụ ọnọdụ, jiri if. Ya mere ụkpụrụ a dị mkpa.
l-e-m3-b04-06.s.s2.model.1: A na-ekpebi between because na if site n'ịma ma ihe ahụ emeworị ka ọ bụ na amabeghị, ya mere ụkpụrụ a dị mkpa n'ezie.

l-e-m3-b04-07.title: Gịnị ka e ji ahọrọ falling na fallen?
l-e-m3-b04-07.goal: Iji chọpụta falling ma ọ bụ fallen dabara, mata ụkpụrụ (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b04-07.material: Na ‘Look at the (falling / fallen) leaves.’, akwụkwọ ndị ahụ nwere ike na-ada ugbu a, ma ọ bụ nwee ike ịdaworị n'ala. Chọta ụkpụrụ maka ịhọrọ.
l-e-m3-b04-07.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụna n'oge ugbu a, ụdị abụọ ahụ nwere ike ịdị mma.
l-e-m3-b04-07.s.s1.r.b: Agba enweghị ike ikpebi ụdị okwu.
l-e-m3-b04-07.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọdịda akwụkwọ ahụ ka na-aga n'ihu ka ọ bụ na ọ gwụla.
l-e-m3-b04-07.s.s1.r.d: Falling na fallen nwere ike ịkọwa aha dị n'ọnụọgụ ọtụtụ.
l-e-m3-b04-07.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ha ka na-ada, jiri falling; ọ bụrụ na ha adaworị, jiri fallen.
l-e-m3-b04-07.s.s2.model.0: A na-ekpebi falling na fallen site n'ịma ma ọdịda ahụ ka na-aga n'ihu ka ọ bụ na ọ gwụla, ya mere ụkpụrụ a dị mkpa.
l-e-m3-b04-07.s.s2.model.1: Ọ bụrụ na ha na-ada ugbu a, bụ falling; ma ọ bụrụ na ha nọworị n'ala, bụ fallen, ya mere ịma ma ọ gwụla bụ ụkpụrụ.

l-e-m3-b04-08.goal: Iji chọpụta ahịrịokwu ndị bụ ajụjụ na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem, mata ụkpụrụ (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b04-08.material: Where did they go? / Do you know where they went? / I know why it stopped. / Why is it closed? Chọta ụkpụrụ a ga-eji họrọ ajụjụ ndị na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem n'ime ndị a.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ụkpụrụ dị ezigbo mkpa iji chọpụta ha.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s1.o.a: Ma okwu ajụjụ sochiri usoro isiokwu + ngwaa n'ime ahịrịokwu ọzọ.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s1.o.b: Ma ọ malitere na okwu ajụjụ.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s1.r.b: Ajụjụ kpọmkwem nwekwara ike ịmalite na okwu ajụjụ.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s1.o.c: Ma e nwere ? na njedebe ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s1.r.c: ‘Do you know ...?’ bụ ajụjụ na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem ọbụna ma o nwere ?.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s1.o.d: Ma ngwaa ahụ dị n'oge gara aga.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s1.r.d: Oge ngwaa enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ajụjụ ahụ ọ̀ bụ nke kpọmkwem ka ọ bụ nke na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s1.explain: Ajụjụ na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem na-adị n'ime ahịrịokwu ọzọ, okwu ndị na-esote okwu ajụjụ na-eji usoro isiokwu + ngwaa.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na isiokwu + ngwaa na-esote okwu ajụjụ n'ime ahịrịokwu ọzọ, ọ bụ ajụjụ na-apụtaghị kpọmkwem, ya mere ụkpụrụ a dị mkpa.
l-e-m3-b04-08.s.s2.model.1: ‘Where did they go?’ bụ ajụjụ kwụụrụ onwe ya, ma ‘where they went’ dị n'ime ahịrịokwu ọzọ, ya mere ụkpụrụ a na-ekewa ha.

l-e-m3-b04-09.goal: Iji chọpụta ma ahịrịokwu dị n'ederede bụ eziokwu ka ọ bụ echiche, mata ụkpụrụ (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b04-09.material: ‘Ogige ahụ na-emeghe n'elekere 9.’ na ‘Ogige ahụ bụ ebe kacha mma n'obodo.’ abụọ yiri ahịrịokwu nkịtị. Chọta ụkpụrụ na-ekewa eziokwu na echiche.

l-e-m3-b04-09.s.s1.o.c: Ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu mbụ n'ederede.

l-e-m3-b04-09.s.s1.r.d: Ogologo enweghị ike ịmata eziokwu na echiche.
l-e-m3-b04-09.s.s1.explain: A pụrụ inyocha opens at 9, ya mere ọ bụ eziokwu; best place dị iche site n'otu onye gaa n'ọzọ, ya mere ọ bụ echiche.
l-e-m3-b04-09.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na e nwere ike iji isi iyi nyochaa ya, ọ bụ eziokwu; ọ bụrụ na ọ dị iche n'otu onye gaa n'ọzọ, ọ bụ echiche. Ya mere ịmata ma a pụrụ inyocha ya bụ ụkpụrụ dị mkpa n'ezie.
l-e-m3-b04-09.s.s2.model.1: A pụrụ iji ọkwa ngosi nyochaa opens at 9, ya mere ọ bụ eziokwu; best na-egosi mmetụta, ya mere ọ bụ echiche. Otu a ka a ga-esi kewaa ha.

l-e-m3-b04-10.title: Olee otú anyị si mara na that bụ relative pronoun?
l-e-m3-b04-10.goal: Chọpụta ụkpụrụ (ozi) dị ezigbo mkpa iji mara that a na-eji dị ka relative pronoun, kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b04-10.material: That dị n'The movie that I saw was fun. bụ nnochi aha relative, ma that dị n'I think that it is fun. bụ onye na-ejikọta. Chọta ụkpụrụ na-ekewa ha.
l-e-m3-b04-10.s.s1.o.a: Ma that dị n'mmalite nke ahịrị okwu
l-e-m3-b04-10.s.s1.r.a: N'ahịrị okwu abụọ ahụ, that dị n'etiti ahịrị okwu.
l-e-m3-b04-10.s.s1.r.b: Oge enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na ụdị that.
l-e-m3-b04-10.s.s1.o.d: Ma ahịrị okwu ka nwere ihe ọ pụtara ma a gbanwee that ka ọ bụrụ which
l-e-m3-b04-10.s.s1.explain: Enwere ike iji which ma ọ bụ who dochie nnochi aha relative that. Enweghị ike idochi onye na-ejikọta that.
l-e-m3-b04-10.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ọ ka nwere ihe ọ pụtara site na which, ọ bụ nnochi aha relative na-akọwa aha tupu ya, ya mere ụkpụrụ a dị mkpa n'ezie.
l-e-m3-b04-10.s.s2.model.1: The movie which I saw na-ada ka okike ma I think which it is na-ada ka ihe na-adịghị mma, ya mere ị nwere ike ikewa ha site n'inwale mgbanwe.

l-e-m3-b05-07.material: N'The story is interesting., interesting bụ adjective, ma n'I am reading a book., reading bụ verb. Chọta ụkpụrụ na-ekewa abụọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b05-07.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ nwere be verb, is na am.
l-e-m3-b05-07.s.s1.r.b: Ogologo enweghị ike ikewa ngalaba okwu.

l-e-m3-b05-07.s.s1.o.d: Ma ọ na-ada nkịtị mgbe very dị n'ihu
l-e-m3-b05-07.s.s1.explain: very interesting na-ada nkịtị, ma very reading na-ada ihe ọjọọ. Naanị adjectives nwere ike iwere very.
l-e-m3-b05-07.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye very n'ihu, very interesting na-ada nkịtị ma very reading na-ada ihe ọjọọ, ya mere ị nwere ike ịkewa ha site n'ụkpụrụ a.
l-e-m3-b05-07.s.s2.model.1: Naanị adjectives ka enwere ike ịkọwa site na very, ya mere nke na-ada nkịtị na very bụ adjective, nke mere ụkpụrụ a ji achọrọ.

l-e-m3-b05-09.title: Ikwu ma enwere ike hapụ relative pronoun
l-e-m3-b05-09.goal: Chọpụta ọkwa (ozi) a chọrọ kpamkpam iji kwuo nke relative pronoun enwere ike hapụ, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ị ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b05-09.material: N'The movie (that) I saw was fun., enwere ike hapụ that, mana n'The man who lives here is kind., enweghị ike hapụ who. Chọta ọkwa na-ekewa ha.
l-e-m3-b05-09.s.s1.r.a: Ọbụlagodi mgbe ọ na-atụ aka n'onye, enwere ike hapụ ya ma ọ bụrụ na ọ na-eje ozi dị ka object.
l-e-m3-b05-09.s.s1.o.b: Ma relative pronoun bụ object ma ọ bụ isiokwu n'clause na-esote ya
l-e-m3-b05-09.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede enweghị ihe ọ gbasara ma enwere ike hapụ ya.
l-e-m3-b05-09.s.s1.r.d: Oge ngwaa enweghị ike ikpebi ma enwere ike hapụ ya.
l-e-m3-b05-09.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-eje ozi dị ka object n'clause na-esote ya na clause ahụ nwere isiokwu nke ya, enwere ike hapụ ya. Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-eje ozi dị ka isiokwu, enweghị ike hapụ ya.
l-e-m3-b05-09.s.s2.model.0: Ma enwere ike hapụ ya na-adabere ma relative pronoun bụ object ma ọ bụ isiokwu n'clause na-esote ya, ya mere a chọrọ ọkwa a.
l-e-m3-b05-09.s.s2.model.1: N'who lives, who na-eje ozi dị ka isiokwu, ya mere enweghị ike hapụ ya, that dị n'I saw bụkwa object, ya mere enwere ike hapụ ya.

l-e-m3-b06-06.goal: Iji chọpụta nke ziri ezi, nsonaazụ oge ugbu a ka ọ bụ nke will, chọpụta ozi dị ezigbo mkpa ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b06-06.material: Ọ bụrụ na osisi enwetaghị mmiri, ha ___ (die / will die). Ọ bụrụ na mmiri ezoghị echi, osisi ndị ahụ ___ (die / will die). Chọta ụkpụrụ na-ekpebi nhọrọ ziri ezi.
l-e-m3-b06-06.s.s1.o.a: Ma osisi ndị ahụ dị n'ọnụọgụ ọtụtụ.
l-e-m3-b06-06.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ ji aha dị n'ọnụọgụ ọtụtụ, ya mere a pụghị iji nke ahụ mata ọdịiche.
l-e-m3-b06-06.s.s1.o.b: Ma ahịrịokwu ahụ ọ̀ bụ nke na-adịghị mma.
l-e-m3-b06-06.s.s1.r.b: Ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ nwere ihe pụtara na-adịghị mma.
l-e-m3-b06-06.s.s1.r.c: Ogologo enweghị ike ikpebi n'etiti oge ugbu a na will.
l-e-m3-b06-06.s.s1.o.d: Ma ọ bụ eziokwu n'ozuzu na-adị mgbe niile ka ọ bụ ihe n'oge a kapịrị ọnụ.
l-e-m3-b06-06.s.s1.explain: Eziokwu na-adị mgbe niile na-eji oge ugbu a (die), ihe n'oge a kapịrị ọnụ dịka echi na-ede will die.
l-e-m3-b06-06.s.s2.model.0: Ịma ma ọ bụ eziokwu na-adị mgbe niile ka ọ bụ ihe n'oge a kapịrị ọnụ na-ekpebi die ma ọ bụ will die, ya mere ụkpụrụ a dị mkpa.
l-e-m3-b06-06.s.s2.model.1: Osisi na-akpọnwụ mgbe niile ma ọ bụrụ na mmiri adịghị, nke ahụ bụ eziokwu n'ozuzu, ya mere bụ die; ihe ga-eme echi bụ will die. A na-eji ụkpụrụ a mata ọdịiche ha.

l-e-m3-b07-05.title: Ụkpụrụ maka ịkewa "whose" na "who's"
l-e-m3-b07-05.goal: Iji chọpụta nke n'ime "whose" na "who's" na-abanye n'ebe efu, kpebie ụkpụrụ (ozi) nke achọrọ n'ezie, ma kọwaa ihe mere i ji họrọ ya.
l-e-m3-b07-05.material: Kpebie ma ị ga-eji "whose" ma ọ bụ "who's" n'ebe efu. ① I met a student ___ bike is blue. ② I met a student ___ riding a blue bike.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ ụkpụrụ achọrọ n'ezie iji kpebie n'etiti "whose" na "who's"?
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.o.a: Ma ọ na-ada nkịtị mgbe e gbasaara ebe efu ka ọ bụrụ "who is"
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.o.b: Ma okwu tupu ya bụ mmadụ
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.r.b: Enwere ike iji ha abụọ mgbe mmadụ, ya mere ọ nweghị ike ịkewa ha.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.r.c: Ọnụọgụ okwu enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na otú a na-eji ha.
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.o.d: Agba nke igwe kwụ otu ụkwụ
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s1.explain: "who's" bụ nkwatu nke "who is." ② na-agụ dị ka "who is riding," ya mere ọ bụ "who's," ma ① enweghị ike ịbụ "who is bike," ya mere ọ bụ "whose."
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s2.model.0: "who's" bụ nkwatu nke "who is," ya mere ọ bụrụ na ọ nwere ihe ọ pụtara mgbe a gbasara ya ka ọ bụrụ "who is," jiri "who's," ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nweghị, jiri "whose."
l-e-m3-b07-05.s.s2.model.1: Ịgụ ya site n'itinye "who is", ② na-ada ka ihe okike ma ① na-ada ka ihe na-adịghị mma, ya mere ụkpụrụ a naanị nwere ike ikewa ahịrị okwu abụọ ahụ.

l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.o.a: Okwu mbụ na-egosi ihe ‘na-eme’, nke bụ ihe na-aga n'ihu.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.a: Ọ naghị emechi ugbu a; ọ nọworị n'ọnọdụ emechiri emechi.

l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.b: Okwu anọ ahụ niile na-egosi nsonaazụ ihe mere ugbua.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.o.c: Okwu mbụ na-egosi ọnọdụ nke ‘emechara’ ma ọ bụ ‘ghọọla’.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.o.d: Okwu mbụ na-akọwa naanị ihe dị mgbe aha gasịrị.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.r.d: N'okwu anọ ahụ niile, okwu mbụ dị tupu aha.
l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s1.explain: Past participle tupu aha na-egosi ọnọdụ ihe emechala ma ọ bụ ghọọla otú ahụ.

l-e-m3-b01-12.s.s2.model.1: Okwu anọ ahụ niile na-egosi otú ihe dị ka nsonaazụ nke ihe emechara, ya mere iwu bụ ọnọdụ "emechara/ghọrọ".

l-e-m3-b01-13.material: ① I wonder how tall the tower is. ② Tell me how far the park is. ③ Do you know how old the building is? Chọta iwu na-abịa mgbe how n'ahịrị okwu atọ ahụ.

l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.o.b: Nkọwa na-arapara ozugbo mgbe how, ma isiokwu + ngwaa na-eso
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.o.c: Ngwaa na-abịa nke mbụ mgbe how
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.r.c: Isiokwu na-abịa nke mbụ, dị ka n'tower is na park is.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.o.d: a na-eji how n'ọgwụgwụ nke ahịrị okwu
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.r.d: N'ahịrị okwu atọ niile, how dị n'etiti ahịrị okwu.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s1.explain: Dị ka n'how tall na how far, how na nkọwa/okwu na-akọwa ngwaa na-abịa nke mbụ dị ka otu mpempe, ma isiokwu + ngwaa na-eso.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s2.model.0: how tall, how far, na how old na-anọ ọnụ, ma isiokwu na ngwaa na-eso, ya mere iwu bụ how + nkọwa + isiokwu + ngwaa.
l-e-m3-b01-13.s.s2.model.1: Nkọwa anaghị ekewa na how ma ngwaa na-abịa mgbe isiokwu, ya mere nke a bụ iwu.

l-e-m3-b02-11.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke ahịrịokwu if atọ na-ekwu banyere echiche, chọta ma kwuo iwu, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b02-11.material: ① If I had a boat, I would sail every day. ② If we lived near the sea, we would swim often. ③ If I were taller, I would play basketball. Chọta iwu n'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.a: If clause na-eji present tense, isi clause na-ejikwa will
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.a: Ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ nwere would, ọ bụghị will.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.b: If clause n'past tense gbakwunyere would n'isi clause na-ekwu banyere echiche
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.c: E dere if clause n'past perfect
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.c: Had a boat bụ simple past tense. Ọ bụghị past perfect.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.o.d: Ọ bụrụ na if dị, isi clause dị n'present tense mgbe niile
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.r.d: Isi clause nwere would, ya mere ọ bụghị present tense.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s1.explain: If + past tense, would + udi isi ngwaa na-ekwu banyere echiche dị iche n'eziokwu ugbu a. Ngwaa be na-ejikarị were.
l-e-m3-b02-11.s.s2.model.0: N'ahịrịokwu atọ niile, if clause dị n'past tense isi clause nwekwara would, ya mere ha na-ekwu banyere echiche gbasara ugbu a.

l-e-m3-b02-12.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke okwu anọ nwere participle mgbe aha gasịrị, chọpụta ma kwuo iwu, wee nwalee iwu ahụ n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b02-12.material: nwatakịrị nọ ọdụ n'akụkụ m / ndị mmadụ na-eche n'èzí / windo bọọlụ gbajiri / achicha nwanne nna m mere. Chọpụta iwu maka otú e si eji -ing na -ed n'okwu anọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.a: A na-eji -ing mgbe aha ahụ na-eme ya, a na-eji -ed mgbe e mere ya aha ahụ.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.b: -ing na-ekwu maka oge gara aga, -ed na-ekwu maka ọdịnihu.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.b: -ing na -ed na-egosi onye na-eme ma ọ bụ onye ihe mere, ọ bụghị oge ngwaa.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.c: N'okwu anọ ahụ niile, -ed bịara mgbe aha gasịrị.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.o.d: E kwesịghị iji participle mgbe aha gasịrị.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.r.d: N'okwu anọ ahụ niile, participle dị mgbe aha gasịrị.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na aha ahụ na-eme ihe ahụ, tinye -ing mgbe ya gasịrị. Ọ bụrụ na e mere ihe ahụ aha ahụ, tinye -ed mgbe aha ahụ gasịrị.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s2.model.0: Nwatakịrị nọ ọdụ na ndị mmadụ na-eche na-eme ihe ahụ n'onwe ha, ya mere -ing; windo gbajiri na achicha e mere ya ihe, ya mere -ed.
l-e-m3-b02-12.s.s2.model.1: Bọọlụ gbajiri windo ahụ, e mekwara achicha ahụ, ya mere iwu bụ -ed maka ihe e mere ya na -ing maka ime ihe.

l-e-m3-b02-13.title: Iwu maka ajụjụ ee/ọ dịghị dị n'ime ahịrịokwu
l-e-m3-b02-13.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ahịrịokwu atọ nwere ajụjụ ee/ọ dịghị, chọpụta ma kwuo iwu ahụ, wee nwalee ya n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b02-13.material: ① Amaghị m ma ụlọ ahịa ahụ emeghewo. ② Ị nwere ike ịgwa m ma ụgbọ ala ahụ egbuola oge? ③ M na-eche ma mmiri ga-ezo. Chọpụta iwu dị n'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.o.a: A na-ewebata ya mgbe niile na that.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.o.b: A na-ewebata ya na if ma ọ bụ whether, n'usoro isiokwu + ngwaa.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.o.c: A na-eji if na njedebe ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.r.c: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile, if dị n'etiti ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.o.d: A na-ewebata ya na okwu ajụjụ where.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s1.explain: A na-ewebata ajụjụ ee/ọ dịghị na if ma ọ bụ whether; ihe na-eso ya na-eji usoro isiokwu + ngwaa.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s2.model.0: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ, isiokwu na ngwaa na-eso if ma ọ bụ whether, ya mere usoro ajụjụ ee/ọ dịghị bụ if/whether + isiokwu + ngwaa.
l-e-m3-b02-13.s.s2.model.1: Ebe okwu ajụjụ adịghị, iwu bụ iji if ma ọ bụ whether kama where ma ọ bụ that.

l-e-m3-b02-14.title: Iwu maka nkebi ahịrịokwu where na-ewebata
l-e-m3-b02-14.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ahịrịokwu atọ where na-ewebata, chọpụta ma kwuo iwu, wee nwalee ya n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b02-14.material: Nke a bụ obodo ebe a mụrụ m. Nke ahụ bụ ụlọ anyị na-eri nri. Ụlọ ahịa m na-arụ ọrụ na ya dị obere. Chọpụta iwu where n'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.a: A na-eji where mgbe aha mmadụ gasịrị.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.r.a: Town, room, na shop bụ ebe niile.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.b: Naanị ngwaa na-abịa mgbe where gasịrị.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.r.b: Isiokwu dịka I ma ọ bụ we bịara mgbe where gasịrị.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.c: A na-eji ya mgbe aha ebe gasịrị, ihe na-esote ya bụ isiokwu + ngwaa.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.o.d: A na-eji where mgbe aha oge gasịrị.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.r.d: Town, room, na shop bụ ebe, ọ bụghị oge.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s1.explain: Mgbe aha na-egosi ebe gasịrị, where na-ewebata nkebi ahịrịokwu pụtara ‘ebe ... na-eme’.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s2.model.0: Town, room, na shop bụ ebe niile, isiokwu dịka I ma ọ bụ we na ngwaa na-esokwa where, ya mere iwu bụ ebe + where + isiokwu + ngwaa.
l-e-m3-b02-14.s.s2.model.1: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile, nkebi ahịrịokwu where na-akọwa aha ebe, ya mere iwu bụ iji where mgbe ebe gasịrị.

l-e-m3-b02-15.title: Mmekọrịta okwu njikọ na-egosi
l-e-m3-b02-15.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ahịrịokwu atọ nwere okwu njikọ, chọpụta ma kwuo iwu, wee nwalee ya n'ihe atụ ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b02-15.material: ① Ụlọ ahụ dị obere, ma ọ na-ekpo ọkụ. ② Mmasị m bụ apụl. Otú ọ dị, nwa nwanne m na-ahọrọ pears. ③ Ụzọ ahụ dị ogologo. N'agbanyeghị nke ahụ, anyị jere ije. Chọpụta ihe but, However, na Still jikọrọ ọnụ n'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.a: Ọ na-enye ihe kpatara ihe e kwuru tupu ya.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ họọrọ mkpụrụ ọzọ, ya mere nke a bụ ọdịiche, ọ bụghị ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.b: Ọ na-egosi echiche dị iche na nke gara aga (ọdịiche).
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.c: Ọ na-emegharị ihe e kwuru tupu ya kpọmkwem.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.r.c: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile, ihe dị iche na nke gara aga na-eso.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.o.d: Ọ na-egosi usoro ihe ndị mere.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.r.d: Ha na-egosi ọdịiche, ọ bụghị usoro.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s1.explain: But, However, na Still bụ akara na-egosi na ihe megidere nke gara aga ga-eso.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s2.model.0: Ụlọ ahụ dị obere ma na-ekpo ọkụ, ụzọ ahụ dịkwa ogologo ma ha jere ije, ya mere okwu atọ ahụ bụ akara ọdịiche na-ejikọta ihe dị iche na mbụ.
l-e-m3-b02-15.s.s2.model.1: Ihe na-eso ya megidere nke gara aga, ya mere ọrụ ha jikọrọ ọnụ bụ igosi ọdịiche.

l-e-m3-b03-11.title: Iwu nke ahịrịokwu atọ nwere unless
l-e-m3-b03-11.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ahịrịokwu atọ nwere unless, kwuo iwu, wee lelee ya site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b03-11.material: ① Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus. ② Unless it rains, we will play outside. ③ Unless you study, you won't pass. Chọta iwu nke unless n'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.a: Main clause na-adị mgbe ihe unless na-eme
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.r.a: N'①, ị naghị efu ya site n'ịgba ọsọ; ị na-efu ya mgbe ị na-agbaghị ọsọ.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.b: Main clause na-adị mgbe ihe unless anaghị eme
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.c: Oge gara aga na-abịa mgbe unless
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile na-eji present tense.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.o.d: A na-eji Unless naanị mgbe main clause
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.r.d: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile, unless dị na mmalite nke ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s1.explain: Unless bụ otu ihe dị ka if ~ not. Main clause na-eguzosi ike mgbe ihe mere mgbe unless anaghị eme.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s2.model.0: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile, nsonaazụ na-esote mgbe ị naghị agbasi ọsọ ike, mmiri ozuzo anaghị ezo, ma ọ bụ ị naghị amụ ihe, ya mere unless bụ if ~ not.
l-e-m3-b03-11.s.s2.model.1: Main clause na-eguzosi ike mgbe ihe mere mgbe unless anaghị eme, ya mere iwu bụ otu ihe dị ka if ~ not.

l-e-m3-b03-12.title: Iwu maka ebe participle na-aga
l-e-m3-b03-12.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke okwu isii nwere participles, kwuo iwu, ma lelee ya n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b03-12.material: the sleeping baby / the baby sleeping in the car; a broken toy / a toy broken by the kids; the running water / the water running from the tap. Chọta iwu maka ọnọdụ nke participles.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.o.a: Participle na-abịa tupu noun mgbe niile
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-abịakwa mgbe noun, dị ka n'the baby sleeping in the car.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.o.b: Otu participle na-aga n'ihu, ma mgbe e jikọtara okwu ọ na-aga mgbe
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.c: Ọ na-abịakwa tupu noun, dị ka n'the sleeping baby.
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.o.d: -ing na-abịa tupu ma -ed na-abịa naanị mgbe
l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s1.r.d: -ed bịakwara ma tupu (a broken toy) ma mgbe (a toy broken by).

l-e-m3-b03-12.s.s2.model.1: N'ụzọ atọ ahụ niile, participle naanị na-aga n'ihu ma mgbe e gbakwunyere nkọwa ọ na-aga mgbe, ya mere nke a bụ iwu.

l-e-m3-b03-13.title: Iwu maka ajụjụ na-abụghị nke ozugbo mgbe asked
l-e-m3-b03-13.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ahịrịokwu atọ nwere ajụjụ na-abụghị nke ozugbo mgbe asked, kwuo iwu, ma lelee ya n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b03-13.material: ① The guide asked where we were from. ② I asked if the train was late. ③ The clerk asked what I needed. Chọta iwu n'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.o.a: Verb mgbe asked bụ present tense mgbe niile
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.r.a: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile, verbs dị n'oge gara aga, dị ka were, was, na needed.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.o.c: Usoro bụ isiokwu + verb, ma verb dị n'oge gara aga
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.o.d: Verb na-abịa nke mbụ mgbe okwu ajụjụ
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.r.d: Isiokwu na-abịa nke mbụ, dị ka n'we were na I needed.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na verb na-ajụ dị n'oge gara aga, mee ka verb nke ajụjụ na-abụghị nke ozugbo dịkwa n'oge gara aga, ma usoro okwu bụ isiokwu + verb.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s2.model.0: N'ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ niile, verb oge gara aga na-eso isiokwu, dị ka were, was, na needed, ya mere isiokwu + verb nwere oge gara aga bụ iwu.
l-e-m3-b03-13.s.s2.model.1: Asked dị n'oge gara aga ma isiokwu na-abịa nke mbụ na-enweghị do, ya mere iwu bụ na verb mgbe ya dịkwa n'oge gara aga.

l-e-m3-b03-14.title: Iwu maka prepositions na relative pronouns
l-e-m3-b03-14.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke relative clauses anọ nwere prepositions, kwuo iwu, ma lelee ya n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b03-14.material: the friend I talked to / the friend to whom I talked / the chair I sat on / the chair on which I sat. Chọta iwu maka ọnọdụ nke preposition n'okwu anọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.a: Preposition na-aga na njedebe nke ahịrịokwu mgbe niile
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.a: Ụfọdụ okwu na-etinye ya na mbụ, dị ka to whom na on which.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.b: Preposition na-aga tupu relative pronoun mgbe niile
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.b: Ụfọdụ okwu na-etinye ya na njedebe, dị ka talked to na sat on.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.o.c: Na njedebe, enwere ike iwepụ relative word; n'ihu, a chọrọ ya
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.r.d: Okwu anọ ahụ niile nwere to ma ọ bụ on.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na ị tinye preposition na njedebe, ị nwere ike iwepụ relative pronoun, ma ọ bụrụ na ị bugara ya n'ihu, ị ga-eji whom ma ọ bụ which.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s2.model.0: Friend I talked to wepụrụ ya ma to whom jiri whom, ya mere mgbe preposition dị n'ihu, whom/which achọrọ.
l-e-m3-b03-14.s.s2.model.1: Na preposition na njedebe, relative word nwere ike ịfụ, ma n'ihu ọ ga-adị, ya mere ọnọdụ bụ iwu.

l-e-m3-b03-15.title: Ịkwekọ ekele na njedebe
l-e-m3-b03-15.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ụzọ atọ nke ekele na njedebe email, kwuo iwu, ma lelee ya n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b03-15.material: ① Dear Principal, … Sincerely, ② Hi there, … Cheers, ③ Dear Teacher, … Best regards, Chọta iwu n'mmalite na njedebe nke email atọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b03-15.s.s1.o.a: Ekele mmalite na njedebe kwekọrọ n'ogo nkwanye ùgwù
l-e-m3-b03-15.s.s1.r.b: ② na-akwụsị na Cheers ma ③ na-akwụsị na Best regards.
l-e-m3-b03-15.s.s1.o.c: Ọ bụrụ na mmalite bụ Dear, njedebe bụ Cheers
l-e-m3-b03-15.s.s1.r.c: Njedebe ndị na-ejikọta na Dear bụ Sincerely na Best regards.
l-e-m3-b03-15.s.s1.o.d: Mmalite na njedebe enweghị ihe jikọrọ ha
l-e-m3-b03-15.s.s1.r.d: A na-ejikọta ekele nwere otu ogo nkwanye ùgwù.
l-e-m3-b03-15.s.s1.explain: Jiri njedebe dị ka Sincerely na ekele nkwanye ùgwù dị ka Dear, ma njedebe dị ka Cheers na Hi nkịtị.
l-e-m3-b03-15.s.s2.model.0: Dear na-esote Sincerely na Best regards, ma Hi na-esote Cheers, ya mere a na-ejikọta ogo nkwanye ùgwù.
l-e-m3-b03-15.s.s2.model.1: Ekele nkwanye ùgwù na ekele nkịtị ọ bụla na-apụta na njedebe nke otu nkwanye ùgwù, ya mere iwu bụ ịkwekọ nkwanye ùgwù.

l-e-m3-b03-25.title: Iwu nke okwu njikọ usoro
l-e-m3-b03-25.goal: Lelee ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ederede isi nri na-eji okwu njikọ usoro, kwuo iwu, ma lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b03-25.material: First, wash the rice. Then, add water. After that, cook it for 20 minutes. Finally, let it rest. Chọta iwu n'okwu njikọ dị na mmalite nke ahịrịokwu anọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b03-25.s.s1.o.a: Okwu njikọ na-agwa usoro ihe na-eme
l-e-m3-b03-25.s.s1.o.b: Okwu njikọ na-emegide ọdịnaya bu ụzọ
l-e-m3-b03-25.s.s1.r.b: First, Then, na Finally na-egosi usoro, ọ bụghị mmegide.
l-e-m3-b03-25.s.s1.r.c: Okwu njikọ anọ ahụ na-agwa usoro, ọ bụghị ihe kpatara.
l-e-m3-b03-25.s.s1.o.d: Okwu njikọ na-abịa na njedebe nke ahịrịokwu
l-e-m3-b03-25.s.s1.r.d: Okwu njikọ anọ ahụ niile dị na mmalite nke ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b03-25.s.s1.explain: First, Then, After that, na Finally bụ mgbama na-agwa usoro ihe na-eme.
l-e-m3-b03-25.s.s2.model.0: Okwu njikọ na-esote ibe ha site na First ruo Finally, ya mere ha bụ mgbama na-agwa usoro.
l-e-m3-b03-25.s.s2.model.1: Nzọụkwụ ọ bụla na-eme n'usoro okwu njikọ ya, ya mere ọrụ a na-ekekọrịta bụ usoro.

l-e-m3-b04-11.title: Ịchọta iwu site n'ihe atụ conditional nke if
l-e-m3-b04-11.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ahịrị okwu conditional na-amalite site na if, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b04-11.material: If it rains, we will stay home. / If he calls, I will answer. / If you run, you will win. Chọta iwu nke ahịrị okwu atọ ndị a.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nkwupụta ziri ezi site n'iji iwu ị chọtara n'ahịrị okwu atọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.o.a: Nkebiokwu isi dị n'oge gara aga mgbe niile
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.r.a: Nkebiokwu isi bụ okwu ọdịnihu na-amalite site na will.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.o.b: Nkebiokwu if na-abịa n'ọgwụgwụ nke ahịrị okwu mgbe niile
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.r.b: Nkebiokwu if dị n'mmalite kpamkpam nke ahịrị okwu.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.o.c: Nkebiokwu if dị n'oge ugbu a, ma nkebiokwu isi nwere will + ngwaa ntọala
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.o.d: E nwere will mgbe niile n'nkebiokwu if na nkebiokwu isi abụọ
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.r.d: Enweghị will n'nkebiokwu if; ọ nwere rains, calls, na run.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ị na-ekwu banyere ihe nwere ike ime, nkebiokwu if dị n'oge ugbu a ma nkebiokwu isi bụ will + ngwaa ntọala.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s2.model.0: N'ahịrị okwu atọ niile, nkebiokwu if dị n'oge ugbu a dị ka rains, calls, na run, ma nkebiokwu isi nwere will na-esote ngwaa ntọala, ya mere nke a bụ iwu.
l-e-m3-b04-11.s.s2.model.1: N'If it rains, we will stay, nkebiokwu if dị n'oge ugbu a ma will dị n'nkebiokwu isi, ya mere otu iwu ahụ na-adabara ahịrị okwu ndị ọzọ kwa.

l-e-m3-b06-11.material: If you finish early, you can go home. / If it is sunny, we may swim. / If you hurry, you should catch the bus. Chọta iwu nke ahịrịokwu atọ ahụ.

l-e-m3-b06-11.s.s1.r.c: Can, may, na should dị n'main clause, ọ bụghị if clause.
l-e-m3-b06-11.s.s1.r.d: A na-eji modal verb present-tense n'main clause, dị ka n'can go.
l-e-m3-b06-11.s.s1.explain: Mgbe if clause dị n'present tense, modal verbs dị ka can, may, na should nwekwara ike ịbịa n'main clause, ọ bụghị naanị will.

l-e-m3-b06-14.title: Ichọta iwu maka otu esi eji what
l-e-m3-b06-14.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke ahịrịokwu nwere relative pronoun what, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b06-14.material: What I need is rest. / What we saw was amazing. / What you said is true. Ahịrịokwu atọ niile pụtara otu ihe ọbụna ma ị gbanwee ha ka ọ bụrụ The thing that ~.
l-e-m3-b06-14.s.s1.o.a: Noun na-abịa tupu what mgbe niile
l-e-m3-b06-14.s.s1.r.a: Enweghị noun a ga-akọwa tupu what n'ikpe ndị ahụ.
l-e-m3-b06-14.s.s1.o.b: A na-eji What naanị maka mmadụ
l-e-m3-b06-14.s.s1.r.b: What n'ikpe ndị ahụ niile na-atụ aka n'ihe.
l-e-m3-b06-14.s.s1.r.c: Subject na-abịa mgbe what, dị ka n'what I need
l-e-m3-b06-14.s.s1.o.d: What pụtara the thing that, ya mere ọ naghị achọ noun tupu ya
l-e-m3-b06-14.s.s1.explain: Okwu ndị what na-edu pụtara 'ihe nke na-eme ~,' ya mere a na-eji ha n'enweghị noun a ga-akọwa.
l-e-m3-b06-14.s.s2.model.0: N'ahịrịokwu atọ niile enweghị noun tupu what, ma ihe pụtara na-anọgide otu ma ọ bụrụ na ị gbanwee ya ka ọ bụrụ the thing that, ya mere nke a bụ iwu.
l-e-m3-b06-14.s.s2.model.1: What nwere noun ọ ga-akọwa n'ime ya, ya mere ọ naghị achọ noun dị iche tupu ya.

l-e-m3-b06-15.goal: Chọta ma kwuo iwu site n'ọtụtụ ikpe nke ederede nwere connectors na-egosi usoro, wee lelee iwu ahụ site n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b06-15.material: First, mix the flour. Next, add milk. Then, bake for 20 minutes. Finally, let it cool. Chọta iwu site n'otu esi eji connectors.
l-e-m3-b06-15.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ nke ziri ezi site n'iji iwu ị chọtara n'ederede.
l-e-m3-b06-15.s.s1.r.b: A na-egosi ihe kpatara site n'okwu dị ka because.
l-e-m3-b06-15.s.s1.r.c: Connectors n'ikpe ndị ahụ niile dị n'mmalite kpamkpam nke ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b06-15.s.s1.o.d: Sequence connectors na-agwa usoro nke nzọụkwụ
l-e-m3-b06-15.s.s1.explain: First, Next, Then, na Finally na-agwa usoro ihe na-eme.
l-e-m3-b06-15.s.s2.model.0: Nzọụkwụ ndị ahụ na-esochi ibe ha site na First ruo Finally, ya mere iwu bụ na okwu ndị a na-agwa usoro.

l-e-m3-b07-02.title: Iwu maka ajụjụ na-abụghị nke ozugbo nke okwu ajụjụ + noun na-edu
l-e-m3-b07-02.goal: Site n'ọtụtụ ihe atụ nke ajụjụ na-abụghị nke ozugbo ebe okwu ajụjụ na noun na-abịa ọnụ, dị ka "what size," chọta ma kwuo iwu, ma lelee ya n'ikpe ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b07-02.material: What color do you like? → Tell me what color you like. / Which road does the bus take? → Do you know which road the bus takes? / Whose bag is this? → I wonder whose bag this is. Chọta iwu ahụ.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.prompt: Tell me ___. (Ajụjụ mbụ: What size do they need?) Kedu nke dabara n'ebe efu?
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.b: E kewara "what" na "size." Okwu ajụjụ na noun bụ otu mpempe.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.c: "do" fọdụrụ, ya mere ọ bụ usoro okwu ajụjụ ozugbo. N'ajụjụ na-abụghị nke ozugbo, "do" na-apụ.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.r.d: Mpempe okwu ajụjụ adịghị n'ihu. Ọ ga-abịarịrị nke mbụ.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s1.explain: Okwu ajụjụ + noun na-abịa nke mbụ dị ka otu mpempe, ma usoro isiokwu + verb na-esote. "do/does" na-apụ.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s2.model.0: Dị ka n'"what color," "which road," na "whose bag," okwu ajụjụ na noun na-abịa nke mbụ dị ka otu mpempe ma "do" na-apụ, ya mere "what size they need" ziri ezi.
l-e-m3-b07-02.s.s2.model.1: N'ihe atụ atọ ahụ niile, isiokwu na verb na-esote okwu ajụjụ + noun ma "do/does" na-apụ, ya mere họrọ "what size they need."

l-e-m3-b01-16.title: Conditional dabara n'ohere nke bọs ịbịa
l-e-m3-b01-16.goal: Tụọ anya iji họrọ ahịrị okwu conditional dabara n'ohere nke bọs ịbịa n'oge, tọọ nha ma ọ bụ ókè ziri ezi, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-e-m3-b01-16.material: Bọs na-abịa n'oge 9 n'ime 10. If the bus comes today, we arrive early, before the movie starts. Họrọ ahịrị okwu na-ekwu banyere ihe na-adị nnọọ ka ọ ga-eme.
l-e-m3-b01-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrị okwu dabara mgbe ọ dị nnọọ ka ọ ga-eme?
l-e-m3-b01-16.s.s1.r.a: Jiri would mgbe ị chere na ohere ịbịa dị ala.
l-e-m3-b01-16.s.s1.r.c: Jiri oge ugbu a, n'enweghị will, n'nkebiokwu if.
l-e-m3-b01-16.s.s1.r.d: Jiri had come maka ihe gara aga n'oge gara aga.
l-e-m3-b01-16.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ọ dị nnọọ ka ọ ga-eme, jiri "if + oge ugbu a, will + ngwaa." Jiri would mgbe ọ na-adịghị ka ọ ga-eme ma ọ bụ echiche.
l-e-m3-b01-16.s.s2.model.0: 9 n'ime 10 pụtara na ọ dị nnọọ ka ọ ga-abịa, ya mere If the bus comes, we will be early dabara.
l-e-m3-b01-16.s.s2.model.1: A na-eji would maka ihe na-adịkarịghị eme, ma bọs na-abịakarị, ya mere ahịrị okwu nwere oge ugbu a na will dị nso.

l-e-m3-b01-17.title: Ihe dị ka ogo ole ka mmiri na-esi ọkụ dị?
l-e-m3-b01-17.goal: Tụọ anya ọnọdụ ọkụ nke mmiri nke boiling water na-ezo aka na ya, tọọ nha ma ọ bụ ókè ziri ezi, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-e-m3-b01-17.material: Usoro nri na-ekwu 'Add the boiling water.' boiling pụtara "na-eme ọkụ ma na-ekpo ọkụ." Tụọ anya ọnọdụ ọkụ nke mmiri a n'ike ikuku nkịtị.
l-e-m3-b01-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ntụ anya kacha mma maka ọnọdụ ọkụ nke mmiri?
l-e-m3-b01-17.s.s1.r.a: 20℃ bụ mmiri ọnọdụ ụlọ, ya mere ọ bụghị mmiri "boiling".
l-e-m3-b01-17.s.s1.r.b: 50℃ bụ mmiri ọkụ ọkụ. Ọ bụghị mmiri na-esi ọkụ.
l-e-m3-b01-17.s.s1.r.d: 300℃ dị elu nke ukwuu. Mmiri na-esi ọkụ na ihe dị ka 100℃.
l-e-m3-b01-17.s.s1.explain: N'ike ikuku nkịtị, mmiri na-esi ọkụ na ihe dị ka 100℃. boiling pụtara na ọ nọ n'etiti ịsi ọkụ.
l-e-m3-b01-17.s.s2.model.0: boiling na-akọwa ọnọdụ nke ịmị mmiri, ma mmiri na-esi ọkụ na ihe dị ka 100℃, ya mere ihe dị ka 100℃ dabara.
l-e-m3-b01-17.s.s2.model.1: 20℃ ma ọ bụ 50℃ anaghị esi ọkụ, ya mere ọ dabaghị, ma 300℃ dị elu nke ukwuu, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 100℃.

l-e-m3-b01-18.goal: Tụọ anya ogologo ụzọ ruo ogige, tọọ nha ma ọ bụ ókè ziri ezi, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-e-m3-b01-18.material: Akara na-ekwu 'Park: 10-minute walk'. Mmadụ na-ejegharị ihe dị ka 80 m n'nkeji 1. Tụọ anya ogologo maka 'Do you know how far the park is?'
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ntụ anya kacha mma maka ogologo ruo ogige?
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s1.r.a: 8 km bụ ihe dị ka ije nkeji 100. Ọ karịrị nkeji 10 nke ukwuu.
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s1.r.c: 80 m bụ ogologo nke nkeji 1. Nkeji 10 dị anya karị.
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s1.explain: 80 m × nkeji 10 = 800 m. Mụbaa oge ije site n'ọsọ ije iji tụọ anya ogologo.
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s2.model.0: Ị na-ejegharị ihe dị ka 80 m n'nkeji 1 ma na-eje nkeji 10, ya mere 80 × 10, ihe dị ka 800 m, dabara.
l-e-m3-b01-18.s.s2.model.1: Nkeji 10 bụ ugboro iri nke ogologo nkeji 1, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 800 m, ma 8 km dị anya nke ukwuu, ya mere ọ dabaghị.

l-e-m3-b01-19.goal: Tụọ anya ịdị elu nke ụlọ nwere ala 40, tọọ nha ma ọ bụ ókè ziri ezi, ma kọwaa ihe akaebe gị.
l-e-m3-b01-19.material: Ụlọ elu nwere ala 40 bụ ụlọ kacha elu n'obodo. Otu ala na-adị elu ihe dị ka 3 m. Tụọ anya ịdị elu nke ụlọ elu a.
l-e-m3-b01-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ntụ anya kacha mma maka ịdị elu nke ụlọ elu?
l-e-m3-b01-19.s.s1.r.a: 40 m sitere n'ịgụ otu ala dị ka 1 m.
l-e-m3-b01-19.s.s1.r.c: 1,200 m sitere n'ịgụ otu ala dị ka 30 m.
l-e-m3-b01-19.s.s1.r.d: 12 m bụ ihe dị ka ịdị elu nke ala 4.
l-e-m3-b01-19.s.s1.explain: Ala 40 × 3 m = ihe dị ka 120 m. Gụọ ọnụọgụ ala site na that has 40 floors ma tụọ anya.
l-e-m3-b01-19.s.s2.model.0: E nwere ala 40 ma otu ala bụ ihe dị ka 3 m, ya mere 40 × 3, ihe dị ka 120 m, dabara.
l-e-m3-b01-19.s.s2.model.1: 1,200 m ga-apụta na otu ala bụ 30 m, nke dị elu nke ukwuu, ma 12 m bụ ịdị elu nke ala 4, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka 120 m.

l-e-m3-b01-20.material: Email ahụ bụ ihe dị ka okwu 360. M na-agụ ihe dị ka okwu 120 n'nkeji 1. Tụọ anya oge ọ na-ewe iji gụọ email a otu ugboro.
l-e-m3-b01-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ntụ anya kacha mma maka oge ọ na-ewe?
l-e-m3-b01-20.s.s1.r.b: N'sekọnd 30 ị na-agụ ihe dị ka okwu 60. Nke ahụ dị n'okpuru okwu 360.
l-e-m3-b01-20.s.s1.r.c: N'nkeji 1 ị na-agụ ihe dị ka okwu 120. Nke ahụ dị n'okpuru okwu 360.
l-e-m3-b01-20.s.s1.r.d: Nkeji 30 bụ oge iji gụọ ihe dị ka okwu 3,600.
l-e-m3-b01-20.s.s1.explain: 360 ÷ 120 = 3, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 3. Kewaa ọnụọgụ okwu site n'ọsọ ịgụ iji tụọ anya.
l-e-m3-b01-20.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na ị gụọ okwu 360 n'okwu 120 n'nkeji 1, ọ bụ gburugburu ịgụ 3, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 3.
l-e-m3-b01-20.s.s2.model.1: Sekọnd 30 na nkeji 1 dị n'okpuru ọnụọgụ okwu a ga-agụ, ma nkeji 30 dị ogologo nke ukwuu, ya mere nkeji 3 dabara.

l-e-m3-b02-16.goal: Tụọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị maka ahịrịokwu ọnọdụ na-eche banyere ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ ghara ikwe omume, kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m3-b02-16.material: Ohere swiiti ga-esi n'igwe daa echi fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ 0%. Kwuo echiche ahụ n'asụsụ Bekee. Họrọ ahịrịokwu gbasara ihe nwere obere ohere nke ime.
l-e-m3-b02-16.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrịokwu dabara mgbe ohere ya fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ 0%?
l-e-m3-b02-16.s.s1.r.b: A na-eji will maka ihe nwere ike ime.
l-e-m3-b02-16.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na nkebi if dị n'oge gara aga, nkebi isi na-ejikọta na would.
l-e-m3-b02-16.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na nkebi if dị n'oge ugbu a, nkebi isi na-ejikọta na will.

l-e-m3-b02-17.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ iberi pizza ọkara e riri fọdụrụ, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m3-b02-17.material: Pizza nwere iberi 8. Ugbu a, ọ bụ pizza e riri ọkara. Half-eaten pụtara ‘eriela ọkara’. Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ iberi fọdụrụ.
l-e-m3-b02-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ dabara maka iberi fọdụrụ?
l-e-m3-b02-17.s.s1.r.a: Ọ bụrụ na iberi 1 fọdụrụ, ọ fọrọ nke nta ka eri ya niile. Ọ bụghị ọkara ka eriri ya.
l-e-m3-b02-17.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na iberi 7 fọdụrụ, ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ dịghị nke e riri.
l-e-m3-b02-17.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na e righị nke ọ bụla, e ribeghị ya.
l-e-m3-b02-17.s.s1.explain: E riri ọkara n'ime iberi 8, ya mere ihe dị ka iberi 4 fọdụrụ.
l-e-m3-b02-17.s.s2.model.0: Half-eaten pụtara na e riri ihe dị ka ọkara, ọkara nke 8 bụ 4, ya mere ihe dị ka iberi 4 fọdụrụ.
l-e-m3-b02-17.s.s2.model.1: Iberi 1 ma ọ bụ 7 dị anya n'ọkara, ya mere ọ ga-abụ ihe dị ka iberi 4, ọkara nke 8.

l-e-m3-b02-19.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ntụ anya kacha mma maka oge ọ na-ewe?
l-e-m3-b02-19.title: Oge ọ na-ewe iji jee ije n'akụkụ osimiri
l-e-m3-b02-19.goal: Tụọ oge ọ na-ewe iji jee ije n'akụkụ osimiri, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m3-b02-19.material: Osimiri na-agafe obodo anyị dị ogologo kilomita 40. Mmadụ na-eje ije ihe dị ka kilomita 5 n'otu awa (1 awa). Tụọ oge ọ ga-ewe iji jee ije n'akụkụ osimiri a n'akwụsịghị ezumike.
l-e-m3-b02-19.s.s1.r.a: N'ime nkeji 80, mmadụ agaghị enwe ike ịga ọbụna kilomita 7. Nke ahụ erughị kilomita 40.
l-e-m3-b02-19.s.s1.r.b: Awa 800 dị ogologo nke ukwuu. Nke ahụ bụ 0.05 km n'otu awa.
l-e-m3-b02-19.s.s1.r.c: Awa 80 dị ka ịga ije 0.5 km n'otu awa.
l-e-m3-b02-19.s.s1.explain: 40km÷5km/h=8 awa. Tụọ oge site n'ịkekọrịta ogologo ụzọ na ọsọ.
l-e-m3-b02-19.s.s2.model.0: Ị ga-eje kilomita 40 n'ọsọ kilomita 5 n'otu awa, ya mere 40÷5 na-enye ihe dị ka awa 8.
l-e-m3-b02-19.s.s2.model.1: Nkeji 80 ezughị n'ihi na mmadụ enweghị ike iru kilomita 7, awa 80 dịkwa ogologo karịa, ya mere awa 8 dabara.

l-e-m3-b02-20.title: Ahịrịokwu ole dị na nzaghachi okwu 50?
l-e-m3-b02-20.goal: Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrịokwu dabara na nzaghachi okwu 50, họrọ nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m3-b02-20.material: Onye nkuzi kwuru ka e dee nzaghachi email nwere ihe dị ka okwu 50. Ahịrịokwu Bekee na-enwekarị ihe dị ka okwu 10. Tụọ ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrịokwu ị chọrọ.
l-e-m3-b02-20.s.s1.prompt: Kedu atụmatụ dabara maka ọnụ ọgụgụ ahịrịokwu?
l-e-m3-b02-20.s.s1.r.a: 1 ahịrịokwu nwere ihe dị ka okwu 10, ya mere ọ dị anya n'okwu 50.
l-e-m3-b02-20.s.s1.r.c: Ahịrịokwu 50 bụ ihe dị ka okwu 500, ya mere ọ toro ogologo.
l-e-m3-b02-20.s.s1.r.d: Ahịrịokwu 500 bụ ihe dị ka okwu 5,000, ya mere ọ toro ogologo.
l-e-m3-b02-20.s.s1.explain: 50÷10=5, ya mere ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 5. Kewaa ngụkọta okwu na ọnụ ọgụgụ okwu n'otu ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b02-20.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụrụ na i kee okwu 50 ka ahịrịokwu nke ọ bụla nwee okwu 10, ị ga-enweta 5, ya mere ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 5.
l-e-m3-b02-20.s.s2.model.1: Ahịrịokwu 50 ga-abụ okwu 500 ma dị ogologo nke ukwuu, ya mere ihe dị ka ahịrịokwu 5 dabara.

l-e-m3-b03-16.goal: Tụ anya oge ọ na-ewe mgbe ị na-anya bọs iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-m3-b03-16.material: Ọ na-ewe nkeji 45 ije site n'ụlọ ruo n'ụlọ akwụkwọ. Bọs na-eru nkeji 20 ngwa karịa ije. Tụ anya ebe efu n'"If we take the bus, we will arrive in about ___ minutes."
l-e-m3-b03-16.s.s1.r.a: Nkeji 2.5 dị obere nke ukwuu karịa nkeji 45.
l-e-m3-b03-16.s.s1.r.c: Nkeji 65 bụ uru ị na-enweta site n'ịgbakwunye nkeji 20 kama iwepụ ya.
l-e-m3-b03-16.s.s1.explain: 45-20=25, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka nkeji 25. Wepụ oge echekwara site n'oge ije.
l-e-m3-b03-16.s.s2.model.0: Ọ dị nkeji 20 ngwa karịa ije nkeji 45, ya mere 45-20 na-enye ihe dị ka nkeji 25.
l-e-m3-b03-16.s.s2.model.1: Nkeji 65 bụ nchikota ma nkeji 250 dị ogologo nke ukwuu, ya mere nkeji 25 bụ azịza kwesịrị ekwesị.

l-e-m3-b03-17.goal: Tụ anya ọnụ ahịa ụgbọala e jiri iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-m3-b03-17.material: Ụgbọala ọhụrụ na-efu dollar 20,000. Ụgbọala e jiri (a used car) na-ere n'ozuzu ihe dị ka ọkara ọnụ ahịa nke ọhụrụ. Tụ anya ọnụ ahịa e jiri nke otu ụgbọala ahụ.
l-e-m3-b03-17.s.s1.prompt: Kedu bụ atụmatụ kwesịrị ekwesị maka ọnụ ahịa e jiri?
l-e-m3-b03-17.s.s1.r.a: Dollar 1,000 bụ naanị 5% nke ọnụ ahịa ụgbọala ọhụrụ.
l-e-m3-b03-17.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-efu otu ihe ahụ dị ka ụgbọala ọhụrụ, nke ahụ abụghị ọkara.
l-e-m3-b03-17.s.s1.r.d: Ọ dị oke ọnụ karịa ụgbọala ọhụrụ. Ọ bụghị ọkara.
l-e-m3-b03-17.s.s1.explain: Ọkara nke 20,000 bụ dollar 10,000. Used pụtara na e jiriwo ya, ya mere ọnụ ahịa na-ada.
l-e-m3-b03-17.s.s2.model.0: Ọ na-ekwu na ọ na-ere ihe dị ka ọkara, ma ọkara nke 20,000 bụ 10,000, ya mere ihe dị ka dollar 10,000 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-m3-b03-17.s.s2.model.1: Dollar 20,000 na dollar 100,000 abụghị ọkara, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka dollar 10,000.

l-e-m3-b03-18.title: Mmadụ ole ka ụlọ egwuregwu nwere ike ịjide?
l-e-m3-b03-18.goal: Tụ anya ọnụọgụ mmadụ n'bleachers nke ụlọ egwuregwu iji kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa echiche gị.
l-e-m3-b03-18.material: 'I wonder how many people the gym can hold.' Bleachers nwere ahịrị 12, ma ihe dị ka mmadụ 20 na-anọdụ n'ahịrị ọ bụla. Tụ anya mmadụ ole nwere ike ịnọdụ n'ụlọ egwuregwu.
l-e-m3-b03-18.s.s1.r.b: Mmadụ 2,400 bụ uru ị na-enweta site n'ịnọdụ mmadụ 200 n'ahịrị ọ bụla.
l-e-m3-b03-18.s.s1.r.c: Mmadụ 24,000 bụ uru ị na-enweta site n'ịnọdụ mmadụ 2,000 n'ahịrị ọ bụla.
l-e-m3-b03-18.s.s1.r.d: Mmadụ 24 fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ otu ahịrị (mmadụ 20). Ọ erughị ahịrị 12.
l-e-m3-b03-18.s.s1.explain: 12×20=240. Mụbaa ọnụọgụ ahịrị site n'ọnụọgụ mmadụ n'ahịrị iji tụ anya.
l-e-m3-b03-18.s.s2.model.0: E nwere ahịrị 12 nwere ihe dị ka mmadụ 20 n'ọ bụla, ya mere 12×20 na-enye ihe dị ka mmadụ 240.
l-e-m3-b03-18.s.s2.model.1: Mmadụ 2,400 ga-apụta mmadụ 200 n'ahịrị ọ bụla, nke buru oke ibu, ya mere mmadụ 240 kwesịrị ekwesị.

l-e-m3-b06-18.s.s2.model.1: 4/5 nke ụmụ akwụkwọ na-agafe, ya mere ọ bụ ihe dị ka ụmụ akwụkwọ 24, nke bụ 4/5 nke 30, ma ihe dị ka ụmụ akwụkwọ 24 bụ azịza kwesịrị ekwesị.

l-e-m3-b06-19.goal: Tụọ ntụnyere n'etiti ịdị elu osisi na ịdị elu mmadụ, kpebie nha ma ọ bụ oke kwesịrị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.

l-e-m3-b07-06.material: Nke mbụ bụ edemede okwu 450. Nchịkọta ọma bụ ihe dị ka otu n'ime ise (1/5) nke ogologo nke mbụ. Tụọ anya ogologo kwesịrị ekwesị maka nchịkọta ahụ.

l-e-m3-b07-06.s.s1.r.a: Nke ahụ bụ ihe dị ka 1/20 nke nke mbụ, nke dị mkpụmkpụ nke ukwuu iji tinye ọdịnaya.
l-e-m3-b07-06.s.s1.r.c: Nke ahụ bụ ọkara nke nke mbụ, nke dị ogologo nke ukwuu maka nchịkọta.
l-e-m3-b07-06.s.s1.r.d: Nke ahụ bụ ogologo dum nke nke mbụ. Ọ bụghị nchịkọta.
l-e-m3-b07-06.s.s1.explain: 450 ÷ 5 = 90, ya mere ihe dị ka okwu 90 kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-m3-b07-06.s.s2.model.0: 450 kewara site na 5 bụ 90, ya mere nchịkọta kwesịrị ịbụ ihe dị ka okwu 90.

l-e-m3-b03-23.s.s1.r.b: N'ajụjụ na-apụtaghị ìhè, ị na-ehichapụ does. Nke ahụ ziri ezi.

l-e-m3-b04-21.title: Ebe nkebiokwu isi na-aga ezighi ezi n'ahịrị okwu echiche
l-e-m3-b04-21.goal: Soro ngwọta e rụrụ gbasara echiche na-adịghị ka ọ ga-eme, ma ọ bụ soro agbụ ihe kpatara na nsonaazụ nzọụkwụ n'nzọụkwụ, wee chọta ebe mbụ ọ na-aga ezighi ezi ma dozie ya.
l-e-m3-b04-21.material: ① Enweghị m ụgbọ ala ugbu a, ya mere ọ bụ echiche dị iche na eziokwu. ② Nkebiokwu if na-eji ụdị oge gara aga had. ③ Nkebiokwu isi na-eji will drive. ④ If I had a car, I will drive to school.

l-e-m3-b04-21.s.s1.r.b: Ụdị oge gara aga had ziri ezi.
l-e-m3-b04-21.s.s1.o.c: ③: Ọ na-eji will drive n'nkebiokwu isi
l-e-m3-b04-21.s.s1.o.d: ④: Ọ na-ejikọta akụkụ abụọ ahụ ọnụ iji mechaa
l-e-m3-b04-21.s.s1.r.d: ④ bụ nsonaazụ nke njehie dị n'③ na-aga n'ihu.
l-e-m3-b04-21.s.s1.explain: Na if clause udi oge gara aga, main clause na-eji would. If I had a car, I would drive ziri ezi.

l-e-m3-b01-27.material: The person who is standing there is a guest. Mee ka who is dị mkpụmkpụ n'ahịrịokwu a iji debe otu ihe pụtara.

l-e-m3-b01-30.goal: Dee ọzọ paragraph akụkọ ụlọ akwụkwọ maka ịkwughachi ihe n'udi dị iche (usoro, tebụl, foto, okwu), ma kọwaa ihe mere ihe pụtara ji bụrụ otu.
l-e-m3-b01-30.material: Otu ụlọ akwụkwọ malitere mmemme ịkwughachi ihe n'March. Ụmụ akwụkwọ na-ahazi akwụkwọ, cans, na plastic. Ọnwa gara aga ụlọ akwụkwọ zipụrụ 300 kg nke mkpofu maka ịkwughachi ihe. Ndị nkụzi na-ekwu na ụlọ ndị ahụ dị ọcha karịa. Mee ka ederede a bụrụ otu ahịrịokwu dị mkpụmkpụ.
l-e-m3-b01-30.s.s1.r.a: Ọ na-ekwu naanị nkọwa ikpeazụ. Ọ bụghị ederede niile.
l-e-m3-b01-30.s.s1.r.b: Ederede ahụ anaghị eme nkwupụta a.
l-e-m3-b01-30.s.s1.r.d: Ọ na-ekwu naanị mgbe ọ malitere. Nke ahụ abụghị isi echiche.
l-e-m3-b01-30.s.s1.explain: Nchịkọta bụ ahịrịokwu nke na-ekpuchi mmalite, ịhazi, ọnụọgụ, na mmetụta. Idee naanị otu nkọwa ezughị.

l-e-m3-b07-04.title: Iji participle phrase maka ihe kpatara njụ
l-e-m3-b07-04.goal: Dee "Because we didn't know the way" ọzọ dị ka participle phrase n'ụdị ọzọ (nhatanha, tebụl, ihe oyiyi, ma ọ bụ okwu) ma kọwaa ihe mere ọ pụtara otu ihe ahụ.
l-e-m3-b07-04.material: Because we didn't know the way, we asked for help. Gbanwee ahịrịokwu a ka ọ bụrụ participle phrase na-amalite na -ing iji mee ahịrịokwu nwere otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ahịrịokwu e gbanwere ka ọ pụta otu ihe.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.r.a: Maka njụ, tinye "Not," ọ bụghị "No," tupu -ing.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.r.c: "not" na-efu, ya mere ọ ga-apụta na ha maara ụzọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.r.d: "known" pụtara "ịbụ onye e mara," ihe ọ pụtara passive, ya mere ọ na-ada ihe ọjọọ.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s1.explain: Njụ participle phrase na-etinye "Not" ozugbo tupu -ing. Isiokwu "we" nke clause mbụ bụ otu na nke abụọ, ya mere a na-ahapụ ya.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s2.model.0: "Because we didn't know" na-adị mkpụmkpụ ka ọ bụrụ "Not knowing," ya mere "Not knowing the way, we asked for help" pụtara otu ihe.
l-e-m3-b07-04.s.s2.model.1: Isiokwu "we" bụ otu n'akụkụ abụọ ahụ, ya mere a na-ahapụ isiokwu nke clause mbụ ma "Not" na-aga tupu -ing, nke na-eme ka ahịrịokwu a pụta otu ihe dị ka nke mbụ.

l-e-m3-b02-35.s.s2.model.0: Ichee site n'ọnọdụ na-ejikwa ọgba ịgụ gị ka ọ ghara ịgbaji, ya mere B ka mma.

l-e-m3-b05-31.material: Nwa akwụkwọ A: "Ohere imeri dị ala nke ukwuu, ya mere If I won, I would ~ dabara." Nwa akwụkwọ B: "Naanị If I win, I will ~ ziri ezi n'ụtụ asụsụ, ma ahịrị okwu would adịghị mma."

l-e-m3-b05-32.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara interesting n'interesting student, họrọ nke kwesịrị ekwesị karị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara gị.

l-e-m3-b05-32.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ adịghị mma: a ghaghị iji -ed
l-e-m3-b05-32.s.s1.r.d: Ọ bụrụ na ị jiri -ed, ọ na-aghọ nwa akwụkwọ na-enwe mmasị.
l-e-m3-b05-32.s.s1.explain: -ing bụ maka onye na-akpata mmetụta. An interesting student bụ nwa akwụkwọ na-enye ndị ọzọ mmasị.

l-e-m3-b05-33.material: Ị chọrọ ịlele ma ‘I wonder where are they going.’ ziri ezi. A: Gụọ ajụjụ dị n'ime ya n'usoro okwu ahịrịokwu nkịtị. B: Lelee ma e nwere akara ajụjụ na njedebe ahịrịokwu.
l-e-m3-b05-33.s.s1.prompt: Họrọ ụzọ kacha mma e si elele ya.
l-e-m3-b05-33.s.s1.r.a: Ụzọ abụọ ahụ na-enyocha ihe dị iche.
l-e-m3-b05-33.s.s1.r.b: A bara uru iji lelee usoro okwu.
l-e-m3-b05-33.s.s1.o.c: A: Lelee ma ajụjụ dị n'ime ya nwere usoro okwu ahịrịokwu nkịtị.
l-e-m3-b05-33.s.s1.o.d: B: Lelee ma e nwere akara ajụjụ.
l-e-m3-b05-33.s.s1.r.d: Akara edemede dị na njedebe ahịrịokwu anaghị egosi usoro okwu dị n'ime ya.
l-e-m3-b05-33.s.s1.explain: Ajụjụ dị n'ime ya ga-eji usoro okwu ahịrịokwu nkịtị, dịka where they are going. A na-enyocha usoro okwu ahụ ozugbo.
l-e-m3-b05-33.s.s2.model.0: Iji mata ma usoro okwu ezighi ezi, gụọ ajụjụ dị n'ime ya ka ọ bụrụ nkwupụta, ya mere usoro A ka mma.
l-e-m3-b05-33.s.s2.model.1: Ma e nwere akara ajụjụ enweghị ihe jikọrọ ya na usoro okwu dị n'ime ya, ya mere A nke na-enyocha ma ọ bụ where they are going ka mma.

l-e-m3-b05-34.title: who na whom: nkọwa nke ziri ezi bụ nke?
l-e-m3-b05-34.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara oghere dị na ‘The man ___ I met’, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m3-b05-34.material: The man ___ I met yesterday is a doctor. Nwa akwụkwọ A: ‘A pụrụ iji naanị whom, who ezighị ezi.’ Nwa akwụkwọ B: ‘Whom bụ iwu ahụ, ma ndị mmadụ na-ejikwa who n'okwu kwa ụbọchị.’
l-e-m3-b05-34.s.s1.o.a: A: A pụrụ iji naanị whom.
l-e-m3-b05-34.s.s1.r.a: A na-ejikarị who eme ihe n'ọnọdụ object kwa.
l-e-m3-b05-34.s.s1.o.b: B: Whom bụ iwu, ma a na-ejikwa who ọtụtụ mgbe.
l-e-m3-b05-34.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ ezighị ezi: naanị that ka a pụrụ iji.
l-e-m3-b05-34.s.s1.r.d: E wezụga that, a pụkwara iji whom na who.
l-e-m3-b05-34.s.s1.explain: Mgbe ọ na-arụ ọrụ object, iwu bụ whom, ma a na-ejikarị who na Bekee a na-ekwu kwa ụbọchị.
l-e-m3-b05-34.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ ezie na whom bụ iwu, ndị mmadụ na-ejikarị who na ndụ kwa ụbọchị, ya mere nkọwa B ziri ezi karịa.
l-e-m3-b05-34.s.s2.model.1: Ikwu na naanị whom ka a pụrụ iji dịka A ekwekọghị n'iji asụsụ eme ihe n'ezie, ya mere B nke nabatara ha abụọ ka ihe akaebe kwadoro karịa.

l-e-m3-b05-35.title: Kedu n'ime nchịkọta abụọ ahụ ka mma?
l-e-m3-b05-35.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ dị n'ahịrịokwu abụọ na-achịkọta ọkwa ọkwa, họrọ nke ka mma ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m3-b05-35.material: Ọkwa ọkwa: A ga-emechi cafe maka ndozi. A ga-eri nri ehihie n'ụlọ mgbatị ahụ ruo ụbọchị 15. Nchịkọta A: ‘A ga-emechi cafe.’ Nchịkọta B: ‘A ga-emechi cafe maka ndozi, a ga-erikwa nri ehihie n'ụlọ mgbatị ahụ ruo ụbọchị 15.’
l-e-m3-b05-35.s.s1.r.a: A hapụrụ ebe na ogologo oge a ga-anọ rie nri ehihie, ya mere ozi ahụ dị iche.
l-e-m3-b05-35.s.s1.r.b: B nwere isi ihe dị n'ọkwa ọkwa, ya mere ọ bụghị ihe na-ezighi ezi.
l-e-m3-b05-35.s.s1.o.c: A: Ọ bụ nchịkọta ka mma n'ihi na ọ dị mkpirikpi.
l-e-m3-b05-35.s.s1.r.c: Ọ dị mkpirikpi, ma e wepụrụ ebe a ga-eri nri ehihie.
l-e-m3-b05-35.s.s1.o.d: B: O nwere isi ihe niile ụmụ akwụkwọ kwesịrị ịma.
l-e-m3-b05-35.s.s1.explain: Nchịkọta dị mma na-enwe isi ihe dị mkpa. B kwuru ọbụna ebe na ogologo oge nri ehihie ga-adị.
l-e-m3-b05-35.s.s2.model.0: B gụnyere ma na-emechi cafe maka ndozi ma ebe na ogologo oge nri ehihie ga-adị, ya mere ọ bụ nchịkọta ka mma.
l-e-m3-b05-35.s.s2.model.1: A dị mkpirikpi ma hapụ ozi nri ehihie ụmụ akwụkwọ kwesịrị ịma, ya mere B nke nwere isi ihe niile dabara karịa.

l-e-m3-b06-31.title: Ịtụnyere ahịrịokwu if na imperative + and
l-e-m3-b06-31.goal: Tụnyere ahịrịokwu abụọ gbasara ịgafe ma ị rụsie ọrụ ike, họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m3-b06-31.material: Nwa akwụkwọ A: 'If you study hard, you will pass.' Nwa akwụkwọ B: 'Study hard, and you will pass.' Tụnyere ihe ahịrịokwu abụọ ahụ pụtara.
l-e-m3-b06-31.s.s1.r.a: B na-ekwukwa na ọ bụrụ na ị rụsie ọrụ ike, ị ga-agafe, nke bụ ọnọdụ.
l-e-m3-b06-31.s.s1.r.b: A nwere "if," ya mere ọ na-egosi ọnọdụ.
l-e-m3-b06-31.s.s1.o.c: Ha nwere ihe megidere ọ pụtara
l-e-m3-b06-31.s.s1.r.c: Ha abụọ pụtara otu ihe: ọ bụrụ na ị rụsie ọrụ ike, ị ga-agafe.

l-e-m3-b06-32.title: Smiling ma ọ bụ smiled: nkọwa onye ziri ezi?
l-e-m3-b06-32.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ gbasara oghere n'"Look at the ___ baby.", họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara ya.
l-e-m3-b06-32.material: Look at the ___ baby. Nwa akwụkwọ A: "It's 'smiling.' The baby is smiling right now." Nwa akwụkwọ B: "It's 'smiled.' -ed shows the past."
l-e-m3-b06-32.s.s1.o.a: Ha abụọ na-ezighị ezi: "smile" ziri ezi
l-e-m3-b06-32.s.s1.r.a: A naghị eji "smile" dị ka okwu na-akọwa tupu aha.
l-e-m3-b06-32.s.s1.o.b: A: Omume na-eme ugbu a ka a na-akọwa site na -ing
l-e-m3-b06-32.s.s1.o.c: B: -ed na-egosi oge gara aga, ya mere "smiled" ziri ezi
l-e-m3-b06-32.s.s1.r.d: "smiled baby" abụghị nkịtị, ya mere ị nweghị ike ikwu na ha abụọ ziri ezi.
l-e-m3-b06-32.s.s1.explain: Ọ bụrụ na nwa ọhụrụ na-eme ọchị ugbu a, ọ bụ "smiling baby." Jiri -ing maka onye na-eme omume.
l-e-m3-b06-32.s.s2.model.0: Nwa ọhụrụ na-eme ọchị ugbu a, ya mere -ing dabara, ma nkọwa A ka mma.
l-e-m3-b06-32.s.s2.model.1: -ed na-akọwa ọnọdụ nke inweta omume, ọ bụghị ihe mere n'oge gara aga, ya mere "smiled baby" na-ada ihe ọjọọ ma A ka mma.

l-e-m3-b06-33.title: If ma ọ bụ whether: nkọwa onye ziri ezi?
l-e-m3-b06-33.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere ebe efu n'"I wonder ___ it is open.", họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-m3-b06-33.material: I wonder ___ it is open. Nwa akwụkwọ A: "Ị nwere ike iji ma 'if' ma 'whether.'" Nwa akwụkwọ B: "Naanị 'whether' na-arụ ọrụ, ma 'if' adịghị mma."
l-e-m3-b06-33.s.s1.o.a: A: Enwere ike iji ma if ma whether
l-e-m3-b06-33.s.s1.o.b: B: Enwere ike iji naanị whether
l-e-m3-b06-33.s.s1.o.c: Ha abụọ adịghị mma: a chọrọ "that"
l-e-m3-b06-33.s.s1.r.c: "that" pụtara "eziokwu na...," ọ bụghị "ma ... ma ọ bụghị."
l-e-m3-b06-33.s.s1.o.d: Ha abụọ adịghị mma: a chọrọ "what"
l-e-m3-b06-33.s.s1.r.d: A naghị eji "what" maka ajụjụ Yes/No.
l-e-m3-b06-33.s.s1.explain: Mgbe a na-atụgharị ajụjụ Yes/No ka ọ bụrụ clause, enwere ike iji "if" na "whether" n'ọtụtụ oge na otu ihe ọ pụtara.
l-e-m3-b06-33.s.s2.model.0: Mgbe "wonder," ma "if" ma "whether" pụtara "ma ... ma ọ bụghị," ya mere nkọwa A ka mma.
l-e-m3-b06-33.s.s2.model.1: "if" nwekwara ike iwebata clause Yes/No dị ka "whether," ya mere A nwere nkwado karịa B, onye kwuru na naanị "whether" ziri ezi.

l-e-m3-b06-34.title: What ma ọ bụ the thing: nkọwa onye ziri ezi?
l-e-m3-b06-34.goal: Tụnyere ụzọ abụọ ma ọ bụ nkwupụta abụọ banyere "What I need is time.", họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-m3-b06-34.material: Nwa akwụkwọ A: 'What I need is time.' Nwa akwụkwọ B: 'The thing what I need is time.' Nke n'ime ha ziri ezi?
l-e-m3-b06-34.s.s1.r.b: B adịghị mma n'ihi na "thing" na "what" na-agbakwụnye ibe ha n'ihe ha pụtara.
l-e-m3-b06-34.s.s1.explain: "what" pụtaworị "ihe nke," ya mere iji ya na "thing" na-eme ka ihe ọ pụtara jiri okpukpu abụọ.
l-e-m3-b06-34.s.s2.model.0: "what" na-anọchi "ihe nke" n'otu okwu, ya mere B, nke na-eji "thing" ọzọ, adịghị mma.
l-e-m3-b06-34.s.s2.model.1: A ziri ezi n'ihi na "what" naanị pụtara "ihe nke...," ma B adịghị mma n'ihi na "thing" jiri okpukpu abụọ.

l-e-m3-b06-35.s.s1.r.b: A na-ekwu isiokwu ma B na-ekwu ọnọdụ, ya mere ha dị iche.

l-e-m3-b06-35.s.s1.r.c: B na-ekwu ọnọdụ na ekwentị kwesịrị ịnọ n'akpa, site n'iji "should."

l-e-m3-b06-35.s.s2.model.1: A na-ewebata naanị isiokwu, ma B nwere nkwupụta onye na-ede, ya mere B bụ ahịrịokwu mbụ ka mma.

l-e-m3-b07-07.title: Where ma ọ bụ which: nkọwa onye ziri ezi?
l-e-m3-b07-07.goal: Tụnyere nkọwa abụọ maka ịhọrọ n'etiti "where" na "which," họrọ nke ka mma, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-m3-b07-07.material: Kedu ga-abanye n'ebe efu, "where" ma ọ bụ "which"? ① This is the cafe ___ I like. ② This is the cafe ___ I meet friends. A: Jiri "where" mgbe okwu maka ebe. B: Ọ bụrụ na ahịrị okwu na-esote zuru oke, jiri "where"; ọ bụrụ na ihe na-efu, jiri "which."
l-e-m3-b07-07.s.s1.o.a: A: Jiri "where" mgbe okwu maka ebe
l-e-m3-b07-07.s.s1.r.a: N'①, ihe nke "like" tọgbọrọ chakoo, ya mere enweghị ike iji "where".
l-e-m3-b07-07.s.s1.o.b: B: Lelee ma ahịrị okwu na-esote zuru oke
l-e-m3-b07-07.s.s1.r.c: Ọ bụrụ na ị soro A, ① na-enye ahịrị okwu na-ezighi ezi.
l-e-m3-b07-07.s.s1.r.d: B dabara ma ① ma ②.
l-e-m3-b07-07.s.s1.explain: N'①, ọ dịghị ihe na-abịa mgbe "like," ya mere ọ bụ "which," ma n'②, "I meet friends" zuru oke, ya mere ọ bụ "where."
l-e-m3-b07-07.s.s2.model.0: N'①, ihe nke "like" tọgbọrọ chakoo, ya mere ọ bụ "which," ma n'②, ahịrị okwu zuru oke, ya mere ọ bụ "where." B bụ nkọwa ka mma.
l-e-m3-b07-07.s.s2.model.1: A na-ekwu na okwu ọ bụla maka ebe na-ewere "where," nke adịghị mma n'①, ma B na-elele ahịrị okwu na-esote, ya mere ọ dabara ahịrị okwu abụọ ahụ.

l-e-m3-b01-36.title: Idee nkwa inyere aka
l-e-m3-b01-36.goal: Tụlee ọnọdụ niile na-emegiderịta onwe ha n'ahịrịokwu na-ekwe nkwa inyere enyi aka n'ọnọdụ, họrọ nkwekọrịta kacha kwesị ekwesị, ma kọwaa ihe kpatara.
l-e-m3-b01-36.material: Ị na-ekwe nkwa inyere enyi aka. Ọnọdụ: ① E nwere ezi ohere na m nwere ike ịgwụcha n'oge. ② Ọ doro anya na m na-enyere aka naanị ma m gwụchaa n'oge. Họrọ ahịrịokwu nke kacha dabara ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ.
l-e-m3-b01-36.s.s1.prompt: Kedu ahịrịokwu kacha dabara ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ?
l-e-m3-b01-36.s.s1.r.a: would na-enye mmetụta na ohere ịgwụcha n'oge dị ala.
l-e-m3-b01-36.s.s1.r.b: unless na-agbanwe ihe pụtara. Ọ ga-apụta na ị na-enyere aka ma ọ bụrụ na ị gwụchaghị n'oge.
l-e-m3-b01-36.s.s1.r.d: Ma will n'if clause ma present tense n'main clause na-ada ka ihe ịtụnanya.
l-e-m3-b01-36.s.s1.explain: Iji gosi ezi ohere na ọnọdụ doro anya, 'If + present tense, will + verb' kwesịrị ekwesị.
l-e-m3-b01-36.s.s2.model.0: Ọ bụ ihe nwere ike ime n'ezie, ya mere If I finish early, I will help you na-emezu ọnọdụ abụọ ahụ, ọ bụghị would.
l-e-m3-b01-36.s.s2.model.1: A naghị anabata Unless n'ihi na ọ na-agbanwe ihe pụtara, ma ahịrịokwu na-eji If na will n'ụzọ ziri ezi na-eme ka ọ doo anya na ị na-enyere aka naanị ma ị gwụchaa n'oge.
